Freya D'Lore is adored for being the wealthiest woman in America, for both having married a big CEO and crafting the #1 most desired jewelry under an alias. 
When she goes to the office to fill in for her husband, she discovers that another woman has taken up her name and is causing havoc in her personal and professional life.

special_desc: Dawn’s fling with a stranger just got a billion-dollar twist: surprise pregnancy, and the baby daddy is none other than billionaire heartthrob Isaac Stanton! You’d think Dawn’s hit the jackpot… except why is she running away?!
share_text: Dream or nightmare? You got knocked up by a billionaire!

book_title: Captured and Bound By My CEO
special_desc: When Lydia West is kidnapped by her rival and forced to marry him for a year to save her dad, she’s sure she’ll hate him forever. But as the truth behind his actions emerges, Lydia is forced to question everything and everyone she thought she knew. Caught between loyalty to her family and her growing feelings for a man she’s supposed to hate, Lydia must decide whether she can resist falling for her captor or let duty tear them apart.
share_text: A lot can change in 365 days.

book_title: The New CEO Turns Out to Be My Gynecologist
special_desc:
Clara is trapped in a year‑long sexless marriage. She develops hypersexuality and seeks medical help—only to meet Dr. Killian, a domineering CEO‑physician who humiliates her during a full exam. That night, her husband Julian rejects her advance, and she discovers he gratifies himself to photos of her half‑sister Vivian—exposing the fraud of her marriage.

The next day, Killian is revealed as her company's new CEO. He promotes her to his personal assistant, exploiting her condition with constant verbal and physical pressure. During a phone call from her own home, with Julian just outside the door, Killian pushes her into a hysterical orgasm, escalating their forbidden tension.

Killian's possessiveness deepens. When his friend shows interest in Clara, he burns with jealousy. At a gala, as he helps her with her zipper, her hysteria ignites. Killian drops all pretense and declares he will "treat her" right there—their relationship teeters on the edge of an irreversible, physical turning point.
share_text: He cured her hysteria. He caused it too.

special_desc: After 15 years of living as a humble orphanage worker, Mary Miller's peaceful life is shattered when a brain hemorrhage leaves her comatose. While her youngest adopted daughter Grace desperately tries to save her life by selling her own blood, her other children Rose and William reveal their true cruel nature. When Mary finally wakes and claims to be Phoenix Group's legendary CEO, she faces brutal mockery and violence. But those who dare abuse the "delusional old woman" are about to learn they've made a terrible mistake—as Mary's vast empire prepares to strike back against all who wronged her family, while rewarding the one daughter who loved her without knowing her true identity.
share_text: The CEO they mocked wasn't who they thought.

special_desc: After the family reunited with their biological daughter, they expelled the fake heiress from their home. She was then taken in by the grandmother of a man, who arranged for her to work at his company. As they spent more time together, both fell in love, and the truth about her real identity began to unravel.
share_text: From outcast to beloved, her true identity is just the beginning of their love story.

special_desc: The Psychic Ace transcended to the mortal body of Annabelle, who could see the countdown of life on people's heads. In her free time, she would treat those with various "strange diseases". Gilbert was one of them. Three years ago, Annabelle saved the dying Gilbert. And she discovered that Gilbert had been cast with Love Spell. Since then, Gilbert had developed feelings for her. Years later, Gilbert recognized her and could no longer control his love for her. He decided to be selfish in his final limited life and propose to Annabelle...
share_text: My goddess and my love, thanks for saving my life.

special_desc:
Kate is a workaholic Wall Street analyst whose body has stopped cooperating. After a clinic mix-up, she meets Landon — the stranger who becomes her unexpected recovery partner.
He can't sleep without intimacy. She needs it to restart her body. So they make a deal: no feelings, no strings, just a temporary arrangement.
But the one person who makes them feel alive is hiding the biggest secret of all.
Landon isn't just her recovery partner.
He's her new CEO.
share_text: She made a no-feelings pact with a stranger. He's her new CEO.

special_desc: Ten months after Nancy Miller’s fateful encounter with Blake Hart, the CEO of Hart Corp, a devastating accident takes her mother’s life. Desperate to secure her newborn daughter’s future, Nancy leaves her at Blake’s doorstep. Later, with a recommendation from her mentor, Nancy joins Hart Corp. As Blake raises their daughter, he embarks on a relentless search across the city for Nancy, eagerly awaiting the day she will return to him and walk down the aisle in the grand wedding he’s been planning all along.
share_text: A baby left at his door, a love story waiting to unfold.

special_desc: Lucas returns to LA as the mysterious CEO of Apex Group, ready to marry his beloved girlfriend, Evelyn. But Evelyn mistakes him for a nobody and leaves him for a "richer man." Little does she know, she just dumped the most powerful billionaire in LA. Then, a stunning female CEO enters Lucas’s life and she gets down on one knee and proposes to Lucas. CEO meets CEO. Together, they become the most powerful couple in the world and make every idiot who underestimated them regret it!
share_text: CEO and CEO, wealth and power, they flip the world.

special_desc: After getting drunk at a bar, Ye Lanxi accidentally spends the night with Lu Yanzhou, the CEO of Lu Group. To her surprise, a passionate night leads to an unexpected pregnancy with his child! Six years later, Ye Lanxi returns to her homeland with her four genius children, embarking on a mission to take down the scoundrels and seek retribution, all while attracting the attention of Lu Yanzhou.
share_text: Returning with Genius Kids, Ye Lanxi Reclaims Her Life.

book_title: CEO, Madam Has A Secret Child!
special_desc: Six years ago, she divorced her CEO husband without him knowing she was pregnant. Now, she lives alone with her child. When they meet again during a blind date, can they clear up misunderstandings and reconcile their broken relationship?
share_text: She divorced her CEO husband after pregnancy. Six years later, they met again during a blind date.

special_desc: After a heart transplant, Violet learns her donor, Eve, died at the hands of her boyfriend, Liam, a famous artist. Seeking proof, Violet signs a BDSM contract to become his servant, but Liam doesn't abuse her—he protects her with a tenderness that terrifies her. When her ex-husband uncovers her lie and blackmails her, Liam quietly makes him disappear. Now Violet faces an impossible truth: she came to destroy a monster, but he may be the only one who truly owns her.
share_text: In a game of pain and passion, who's the prey now?

special_desc:
Five years ago, we fell in love, but his mother forced me to leave him. Shortly after we broke up, I discovered I was pregnant! 
Initially, I had decided to raise the child on my own, but the child was diagnosed with leukemia and urgently needed a bone marrow donation. Helpless, I sought him out, hoping he could save our child. However, his fiancée continuously interfered, creating numerous obstacles. Will my child survive, and can we get back together?
share_text: To save my child, I return reunite with my ex-boyfriend.

special_desc: She has a terminal illness, yet she sees her husband bringing her sister home. He doesn't believe her, tormenting her. An accident makes her forget everything. Yet he refuses to let her forget him...
share_text: CEO, your wife is dying, and you're still being deceived by the mistress?

book_title: Billionaire Luna: Taming My Alpha Mates
special_desc:
A workaholic transmigrates as Princess Aria, whose F-class mental powers were faked and who was murdered by her male favorite. She binds to a pay‑to‑win system that gives tenfold rebates and unlocks divine artifacts.

Her ambitious sister Elena keeps laying traps: poison, forged evidence, a fleet‑polluting scheme, and a killing array on the altar. The heroine breaks through with money and wit. She saves the silver wolf commander Jace, tames the white tiger war god Bastian, rescues mermaid General Cassian, and outmaneuvers the nine‑tailed fox Malakai.

In the final crisis, she carriers the Tears of the Gods in her body, awakens the SSS‑rank golden bloodline, destroys the Black Current organization, purifies the World Tree, and dissolves the orcs' thousand‑year resentment.

She is crowned queen, enacts new policies to protect orcs, and four loyal companions stand by her side. The villains fall, and the empire enters a new era of peace and prosperity.
share_text: She brought cash to a war of beasts. She won.

special_desc:
Charlotte, adopted daughter of the Harrington family, is drugged and framed by her stepsister Isabella at her engagement banquet. Locked in a tower, she becomes entangled with William, heir of the Ashford family. Pregnant and cast out, Charlotte raises her son Leo alone for eight years.

An alumni dance reunites them. William recognizes Charlotte by his mother's ruby pendant. Desperate for money, Charlotte works at his hotel, and they sign a three-month contract to fake a relationship. Spending time together, William discovers Leo shares his looks and peanut allergy — proof Leo is his son.

Isabella keeps scheming, but her past crimes are exposed. Charlotte is finally recognized as a true Harrington. Leo recovers from surgery, the contract blossoms into real love, and the family of three is happily united.
share_text: The contract was fake. The family was real.

special_desc: Mia Harper, down on her luck, marries wealthy CEO Carter Prescott as part of a deal. Their fake marriage soon blossoms into real romance, but their love is tested when Carter's ruthless ex, Lily, stops at nothing to win him back. The drama intensifies when Mia discovers she's pregnant with Carter's baby and uncovers the shocking truth that Lily is her long-lost stepsister...
share_text: You’re getting married and you don’t know his last name?! But you have to go through with it...

special_desc: 5 years ago, Sienna and Damian had an one night stand. Now, she's back with their daughter Poppy as the CEO of a huge production company in LA. To reconnect with them, Damian hides his billionaire identity and becomes Poppy's manny. Will they stand against the world and build a new life as a family?
share_text: The hot manny you hired turns out to be a CEO!

special_desc: Billionaire Blake Thorne returns on Chinese New Year's Eve to surprise his wife, only to find her pregnant. He reveals his true wealth, leaving her family in regret as he cuts all ties.
share_text: Billionaire's new year homecoming, shocking betrayal awaits.

special_desc: A rural girl who sells pork unexpectedly meets a secretive billionaire CEO. They have a whirlwind marriage, and their feelings gradually deepen. However, when his first love appears, cracks start to form between them, and billionaire's true identity becomes a ticking time bomb for their marriage.
share_text: The butcher shop girl married him, but he was actually a hidden billionaire?!

book_title: Big Molly The Billionaire's Only Cure
special_desc:
Molly Hart runs a street food truck called Big Molly’s Hot Dogs with her adoptive parents. People love to joke about the name—and about Molly herself—but she never lets it get to her. If anything, she turns it into part of the brand.
Meanwhile, Adrian Blackwood, heir to the Blackwood empire, has gone days without being able to eat. The best doctors, private chefs, and nutritionists money can buy have all failed to help him.
Then Charles brings one of Molly’s hot dogs back to the estate. What was meant to be a simple meal unexpectedly catches Adrian’s attention. For the first time in days, he willingly takes a bite—and his condition immediately begins to improve.
The moment Adrian learns the hot dog came from a food-truck girl named Molly Hart, he sets out to find her.
Neither of them expects that a relationship beginning with food, money, and a very unusual arrangement will eventually turn into something neither can walk away from: real dependence, real desire, and real love.
share_text: His illness defied doctors—but her hot dogs cured him.

special_desc: When an explosion destroys Dr. Jen Connor’s lab, billionaire heir Roman Johnson rescues her and her comatose sister. Jen offers Roman one impossible deal: she'll pose as his sweet, old-fashioned fiancée for one weekend, so his cold, powerful father may restore the foundation funding she desperately needs. But inside the lavish Johnson estate, Jen faces ruthless tests from staff, family and Roman’s venomous ex-fiancée Kim, who begins to suspect the truth. As romantic tension builds between Jen and Roman, so does the risk of discovery. What starts as a lie becomes dangerously close to real love, just as Kim uncovers the secret Jen hoped would stay buried.
share_text: One Weekend. One Lie. Countless Secrets.

special_desc: Fresh out of prison, Graziela is desperate for a fresh start. Her only chance is a job as a nanny for Alex, a ruthless billionaire who cares about only one person—his daughter. Alex puts Graziela through a series of brutal tests, determined to keep the mysterious nanny away from his little girl. But Graziela proves herself, slowly winning over the child—and the cold heart of the billionaire father. Just when Graziela begins to believe she can finally leave her past behind, the secret she's been hiding threatens to destroy everything she's built. She finally found a family worth fighting for. But when Alex discovers the truth, will he ever forgive her?
share_text: Fresh out of prison, she became the billionaire’s nanny—and his biggest secret.

special_desc: Aria Walker needs a husband to get out of an arranged marriage. When her long-term boyfriend reveals he's leaving her for her best friend, a heartbroken Aria turns to old acquaintance/"food truck worker," Stefan Hill. Little does she know Stefan Hill is actually a billionaire CEO. Aria's selfish family and bitter best friend try to sabotage her at every turn, but with Stefan's support, Aria's marriage only gets stronger.
share_text: My new husband is actually a billionaire?!

book_title: The Alpha Princess Is Gone for Good
special_desc: Pampered real alpha princess Evie is framed and sent to the ruthless Werewolf Military Academy by her own family. They believe she is living comfortably, completely unaware that under the fake alpha princess's orders, Evie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she returns, broken inside, yet her family still views her as a spoiled brat. It is only when her father strikes her and her prosthetic limb falls off that they finally realize the horrifying truth...
share_text: When her Alpha father struck the "spoiled" heiress, her prosthetic limb shattered on the floor—and the pack finally realized the horrifying truth.

special_desc: Xanthea Plath, an illegitimate child of the Alpha of Virgo pack, was an omega and omegas weren't allowed to dream, yet she never stopped dreaming. She wanted to be a doctor just like her mother but the luna of the pack, her stepmother would break her physically and mentally and stop at nothing to crush all her dreams. Xanthea had still found a way though all the abuse her steps put her through. But one day her world came crashing down right before her entrance in a medical college when she found out that she was being offered as a bride to the ruthless triplet alphas also known as the demon lords of the Infernal pack of the underworld. Xanthea had heard the horrifying stories of several suitors who had come before her, all of whom had met a gruesome end.
share_text: You can’t be weak, wife. You now have three husbands to please

special_desc: Abandoned as an infant for lacking a "wolf spirit," Kyle is raised by three Legendary Beasts in the Beast Forest. Eighteen years later, he has not only grown into a fierce fighter but also awakened the hidden power of a dragon within him. Seeking his parents, Kyle rescues Freya, the Princess of the Silvermoon Pack, and follows her to the Crimson Flame City.  There, he discovers that Elina, a disgraced slave tormented by the pack's hypocritical Alpha, Alaric, is actually his birth mother. Just as they reunite, the Thunderclaw Pack launches a devastating invasion. While Alaric and the cowardly heir Kent surrender and betray Freya to save themselves, Kyle steps forward, unleashing his dragon-wolf bloodline to crush the invaders.  However, a darker conspiracy emerges: the Thunderclaw Pack has allied with the Liches, an evil undead race bent on destroying the world. Facing the terrifying Lich King and an endless army of ghouls, Kyle is empowered by Freya's holy light and the united strength of every werewolf worldwide. Transforming into a colossal silver wolf, Kyle defeats the Lich King and saves the realm. In the end, his father, the ancient dragon Vodar, awakens from his slumber, reuniting their family. Kyle claims his rightful place as the new Alpha of the Crimson Flame Pack and finds true love with Freya.
share_text: Abandoned as a weakling, he returns with the power of a dragon! Watch the Dragonblood Werewolf save his mother, crush the Alpha, and destroy the Lich to save the world. Witness the ultimate comeback!

special_desc: My daughter can still see me. Everyone else sees only an empty room. Before I died, I told her one thing: "Don't tell Daddy Mommy's dead." The Alpha who once loved me thinks I abandoned our child and disappeared again. He's hunting me across the packs, promising the cruelest revenge. The only problem? I'm already standing beside him... as a ghost. When he finally discovers the body they pulled from the river, will regret come too late?
share_text: I haunt him as ghost, he hates my departure.

special_desc: Ethan, the cursed Alpha of Silver Moon, needs a Luna who can survive bearing his heir. Hope, a poor outland Omega, enters the mate selection to save her pack — and accidentally awakens ancient wolf power. Forced into a bond, Ethan rejects her at first. But when Hope risks her life for him, hate turns into obsession. Now they must break the Luna curse before their mate bond kills her.
share_text: He rejected her at first—now he'll burn the world to save her.

book_title: Mated to the Alpha and His Beta
special_desc: On mating night, Charlie is claimed by the Alpha and his Beta. By morning, she's publicly declared "unsatisfactory" and replaced. But when she discovers she can hear their private mind-link—and their chosen mate can't—the question becomes: if she was never meant for them, why is she the only one who feels the bond?
share_text: The bond wasn't broken. It was just waiting to be heard.

special_desc: Bullied and mistreated, a young High School girl is shunned from her previous pack for not having a wolf. Upon entering a new pack, she meets a dashing man who falls in love with her – except this man is her superior Alpha and the nephew of the one man that wants her dead.
share_text: Will your mate abandon you when he discovers who you really are?

book_title: My Alpha Cheated on Our Mating Day
special_desc: On the morning Aria should become Dominic’s Luna, he leaves her at the cathedral to mark another woman. He thinks ten years of devotion means she will wait in white and forgive anything. Instead, Aria calls Alexander, the Alpha she once rejected and the fated Mate Dominic never knew she had. Before three hundred werewolf elites, she turns Dominic’s dream ceremony into her own revenge wedding. One bite, one contract, one public vow, and the Alpha who thought she had no choice loses the Luna who built his Pack.
share_text: A broken vow. A true Mate. A revenge wedding. His biggest regret begins.

book_title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me
special_desc: The wolfless Lyra, has been captive in the Wolfsbane pack for seven years, during which she was constantly abused by Alpha Roland. During one of her escapes, Lyra has an accidental one-night stand with Alpha Alfred, Moonshadow pack's strongest Alpha, and becomes pregnant with his child. Alpha Alfred rescues Lyra from Alpha Roland and brings her back to his pack. To protect her, Alfred and Lyra form a Fake Luna contract.
share_text: Two Alphas fight for one servant girl.

book_title: Countdown to Leaving the Alpha King
special_desc: Five days before the wedding, Princess Mina discovers that Alpha King Lucien is only marrying her to seize the Moon Goddess's power through her bloodline. Once he succeeds, he will reject her and wed her sister Elise, his true love. Heartbroken, Mina secretly swaps places with Elise and agrees to become the Vampire King's bride. On the wedding day, Lucien lifts the veil and finds Elise standing in Mina's place. In that crushing moment, he finally realizes that Mina is the one he truly loves. But it is too late. Mina is already sealed inside the vampire's coffin, lost to him forever. He kneels in the empty hall, screaming her name into the silence. No answer comes. Regret drowns him, and the woman who gave him everything is gone, never to return.
share_text: He wanted her blood. He lost her soul.

book_title: Revenge in My Ex's Brother's Bed
special_desc: Three years ago, rising star Danny lost everything after being betrayed by the two people he trusted most. Everyone believed he was gone for good. Now he's back with a new identity and a carefully planned revenge. His target? The ex-lover who destroyed his life and the best friend who helped cover it up. But things take an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with Allen, the younger brother of the man he hates most. What starts as a dangerous game soon becomes something neither of them can control. As old secrets resurface and feelings grow stronger, Danny must decide, finish his revenge, or risk everything for the one person he never meant to love.
share_text: My ex stole my career and life. After rebirth, I'd take everything back and his brother's love.

special_desc: Charlie was abandoned by his wealthy family as a baby, left for dead in a fire. 25 years later, his family comes looking for him. Finally, he'll get to have a real family! As a smart genius, he helps the family business grow by billions. But when it comes time to pass out the bonuses, his fake brother gets millions, but they only hand him a penny. Is this what his family truly thinks about him? When will he stand up and take back what truly belongs to him?
share_text: My family loved my fake brother, but not me.

special_desc:
Emma, the wife of the founder of a Paris‑based fashion brand, endured long‑term humiliation and betrayal from her husband Maxime, her best friend Camille and her sister‑in‑law Valerie because of her weight. She was even pushed off a terrace and locked in a cold storage room to die. On the brink of death, she was rescued by her biological grandfather Henri, who had been searching for her for years. She learned that she was the sole heir to the Villard fashion empire.

With the companionship of her childhood sweetheart Lorenzo, Emma rebuilt herself over seven months. She made a glamorous comeback under the identity of Adele Villard and carefully laid out schemes to take revenge on those who had betrayed her. In the end, she exposed their crimes, took over the empire, and embarked on a brand‑new life.
share_text: They left her to freeze. She returned to burn them all.

special_desc: I died broken, my unborn baby killed by my fiancé Kael and his scheming sister Celestia. Reborn, I dumped him and married his mighty uncle Dravon to get revenge. Kael torments my silver dragon, insults me publicly, even kidnaps me on my wedding eve. Trapped in a cursed arena, chained and drained of magic, I thought all hope was lost—until ancient dragon power bursts from my veins. Everyone kneels, and a ghost reveals my hidden identity: the sacred Dragon Lord. Can I make Kael pay for two lifetimes of pain?
share_text: I reborn to marry my cruel ex-fiancé’s powerful uncle, only to unlock my forgotten identity as the lost sacred Dragon Lord and crush all my tormentors.

book_title: Revenge Groom Is My Ex's Uncle
special_desc: Betrayed by Brian and his mistress, Hailey decides to seek revenge by marrying his uncle! But she doesn't realize that she has already met the man she wants to marry!
share_text: Oops, I'm marrying my ex's uncle.

special_desc:
After centuries of silence, she rises again.
Buried in blood and betrayal, Scarlett has returned from death — resurrected by the only soul who ever truly loved her, Alexa.
Once sisters by choice and bound by destiny, their story was written in curses, torn apart by betrayal, and sealed beneath centuries of dust. But now, the dead walk again—seeking vengeance.
As Scarlett reclaims her power, she and Alexa wage war against the Salvatore brothers and the ancient vampire Edgar, the Original who cursed their bloodline. Shadows tighten around them, weaving together witchcraft, prophecy, and the unbreakable chain of the sire bond.
In a world ruled by immortality, love becomes both weapon and weakness. Old wounds burn brighter than ever, forcing Scarlett to face one haunting truth—revenge comes with a price, and sometimes that price is love itself.
REVENGE AFTER CENTURIES — a saga of resurrection, betrayal, and revenge that defies time.
Some loves never die. Some hatreds never fade.
share_text: From ash to fang: Scarlett's resurrection isn't a miracle—it's a warning.

book_title: Sisterhood of Lies: Pledge for Revenge
special_desc: After Ashlyn dies in a sorority hazing “accident,” her identical twin sister June takes her place to get revenge on the real killers — Ashlyn’s back-stabbing bestie and her frat-bro boyfriend.
share_text: Ramma Phi, You're Gonna Die!

special_desc: Skye, Marchioness of Everford, devoted her life to managing her estate, only to be betrayed and killed by the very children she raised. On the brink of death, she discovers the shocking truth: the heirs she loved were not her own, while her true-born children suffer in silence. Reborn on the night before her murder, Skye awakens with crystal-clear clarity and a plan for ruthless revenge.
share_text: The Marchioness returns. This time, no mercy.

special_desc: Hailey's father adopted three boys from the orphanage - the Miller brothers, who showered her with endless love and care. She even thought she would end up with one of them. But everything changed when the maid's daughter, Blair, came. They robbed Hailey's family fortune and her life. Now reborn, Hailey chooses to punish the Miller brothers and allies with the one person they fear. This time, the Miller brothers' world is going to shatter.
share_text: They were her brothers, her protectors, her first love. They became her murderers.

special_desc: Skye, Marchioness of Everford, devoted her life to managing her estate, only to be betrayed and killed by the very children she raised. On the brink of death, she discovers the shocking truth: the heirs she loved were not her own, while her true-born children suffer in silence. Reborn on the night before her murder, Skye awakens with crystal-clear clarity and a plan for ruthless revenge.
share_text: The Marchioness returns. This time, no mercy.

special_desc: After a tragic car accident, the parents redirected all blood supplies to save the brother, causing her to ultimately languish and die on her hospital bed. Reborn, she finds herself back at the age of ten. Determined not to survive as she did in her previous life, she plans to take revenge, strip the family of everything, and make her mother regret her actions.
share_text: Back to Childhood with a Heart Full of Revenge.

special_desc: Lyla's path to vengeance begins with her working as a waitress in a prestigious restaurant, a far cry from the life she once knew. With each passing day, Lyla's transformation is remarkable. She evolves from a broken-hearted waitress into a formidable and cunning businesswoman, fueled by a quest for revenge, works her way to the top. Does she get her desired revenge?...
share_text: You need this in a long night.

special_desc: Ava Russell on the eve of her arranged marriage, is drugged by her fiancé Nico Moretti and has her hair brutally shaved off by his comrade Scarlett. Refusing to swallow this humiliation, Ava secretly contacts Damian Costello, the powerful heir of the Costello family who has secretly loved her for twelve years. On the wedding day, when Nico tries to sneak Ava into his family through a shabby, hidden ceremony and Scarlett publicly strips off her wig to mock her, Damian arrives with a magnificent fleet to marry Ava in style. With the help of Damian and the Commission, Nico and Scarlett are stripped of their power and arrested for violating family laws, while Ava finally finds her true protector and happiness.
share_text: Shaved bald by my trash fiancé's girl, I married his billionaire rival on our wedding day.

special_desc: She sacrificed her career for her husband, only to discover he was cheating and secretly transferring marital assets. To gather evidence for a divorce, she guided her husband's mistress to see his true colors and convinced her to cooperate. Will the alliance between these two rivals be unbreakable or filled with jealousy?
share_text: After being cheated on, I actually teamed up with my husband's mistress?

special_desc: Gordon James left for a battalion the day after his wedding with Daphne Kirk. Seven years later, Daphne took their son Freddy to Gordon's camp to meet his dad. There she found out he got married to another woman in the camp. Conflicts with his new wife Flora and her mom Jane led to Freddy dying on the trip. Daphne swore to avenge her son with help from her father, Marshal Simon Kirk. Gordon killed Jane to win his powerful father-in-law's favor, only to get killed by Flora who then committed suicide.
share_text: "Everyone who hurt you, I'll make them all pay."

special_desc: After his sister dies due to losing health coverage, Matteo Leone, a broken man, takes justice into his own hands by killing the insurance company CEO. But he isn't just out for revenge, he has a bigger goal: Expose corrupt health insurance companies for preying on their most vulnerable customers. Matteo stays one step ahead of the police, leaving a trail of clues to send his message, soon becoming a hero to the people the evil CEO's thought they could silence.
share_text: Deny, defend, depose. CEOs are about to go down.

book_title: My Gorgeous Wife is an Ex-Convict
special_desc: Brielle is wrongfully accused of killing her fiancé's sister. Her fiancé refuses to believe her, and sends her to rot in prison. Three years later, after her release, Brielle works to prove her innocence. A mysterious and handsome stranger, Jay, lends her a helping hand... But there may be more to him than what meets the eye.
share_text: You were sent to prison for a crime you didn't commit. Now it's time to clear your name!

book_title: Secret Boss of the Five Keys
special_desc: Grayson Rodgers is a gardener with a secret: Over the last five years, he's taken out the five heads of the Five Nation Syndicate, and taken their Gold Keys: The symbols of their authority, but also the keys to the vault that acts as a bank for their entire fortunes. He's now ready to stop, and give his wife a life of luxury and peace. But before he can reveal himself to her, he discovers her sleeping with a high ranking syndicate general, Ivan. Ivan wants Grayson to use his clearance as a gardner to help him break into the Golden Key Vault. Now Grayson must find a way to prove to everyone that he's the true leader, while catching Ivan in the act... all the while being thought of a just a gardener.
share_text: He went from gardener, to leader of the mafia.

special_desc: After realizing she's been hating the wrong man her entire life, Elena dies in the arms of her husband Marcus. In a twist of fate, Elena is brought back in time. It's not too late, she still has time to change everything. In this life, she won't hate her husband... she will protect him at all cost.
share_text: You've hated your husband since forever, until death brings you the truth! It's time for redemption!

special_desc: Nora was a rising defense attorney until her fiancé Adrian perjured himself on the stand, framing her and sending her to prison for three years. She emerged to find Adrian with Brooke—the real Bennett heir, who killed her own best friend Emma and stole her song. Nora quietly allied with Julian (the wrongly convicted man's cousin) and Emma's father Frank. Frank retrieved a deleted recording from Brooke's home: Brooke ordering the murder. In court, Nora exposed everything. Brooke got life. Adrian fell. Nora reclaimed her law license, cut ties with all who betrayed her, and began again with Julian.
share_text: Fiancé framed her and sent her to prison. She returned—and buried him and the real killer in court.

special_desc:
Serena Hale was a devoted wife. But her husband hadn't touched her in months. So when a stranger pulled her from a bar one night, she surrendered to him - because in her drugged haze, she thought he was her husband.
One mistake.
That stranger is Evan Knight - the billionaire underworld king now funding her husband's company. He knows she's married. He doesn't care.
He's been waiting for her for sixteen years - since the rainy night she saved a beaten boy in an alley and didn't even remember his face. But he remembered everything. Her piano. Her voice. The way the rain clung to her white dress.
Now he sits across from her at every dinner, watches her husband fake devotion, and whispers: "You don't belong to him."
And the worst part?
She's starting to agree.
Even as she discovers that her husband murdered her parents. Even as she plans her revenge. There's only one man she trusts with the blade.
But trusting him means betraying herself. And she's already fallen for him.
share_text: She saved him once. He's been hers ever since.

book_title: Mafia's Love Left Me No Way Out
special_desc: Rosalia and Nick, the son of a mafia boss, were once a loving engaged couple — but a misunderstanding turned them into each other's killers' enemies. Torn between love and hatred, Nick decided to train Rosalia into the most lethal assassin in the mafia as atonement. After seven years of training, Rosalia began carrying out missions with outstanding results. One day, Nick gave her a new assignment: get close to Dominic, the son of a rival mafia family, and become his girlfriend to earn his trust. A tangled web of love, hate, and vengeance between the three unfolded from there…
share_text: He trained her to kill. Then sent her to love his enemy.

book_title: Mafia's Desire for the Wet Nurse
special_desc:
Elena is drugged by her stepfather and, at a masked ball, has a night with Vincent—a powerful heir who can't touch any woman due to childhood trauma. She gives birth to Leo, but Frank sends the baby to an orphanage. Vincent recognizes his tie at the scene, adopts Leo, and brings him home.
Desperate to reclaim her child, Elena applies as a wet nurse at Cunningham Manor, reuniting with Vincent—neither recognizes the other. Leo only drinks Elena's milk. Vincent discovers Elena is the only woman he can touch without repulsion, and gradually falls for her.
Frank's schemes and Lina's sabotage are repeatedly thwarted by Vincent. Elena learns her child has been "adopted" by the Clintons, but discovers the child isn't hers—the orphanage director was deceiving her. Vincent produces the tie: Leo is her son, and Vincent is the masked man from that night.
Vincent confronts his father Charles, exposing the abuse that drove his mother to suicide. Charles concedes, accepting Elena. The family of three reunites in a grand wedding.
share_text: She sold her milk. He bought her love. Their child brought them home.

special_desc: FBI Agent Parker is assigned a covert mission: go undercover as the heiress to a mafia family and become the bride at a gangster wedding. But before she walks down the aisle, the groom is a no-show—and in his place stands his older sister, Thea: the old flame Parker coldly killed on an undercover assignment three years ago.
share_text: FBI agent marries the ex she gunned down three years ago.

book_title: The Mafia Boss My Husband Betrayed
special_desc: Emma is alone after her husband leaves on a mafia mission, trapped by a painful blocked milk duct and a crying baby. Then Dante Vella, her husband’s wounded mafia boss, breaks into her home, hiding from killers outside. To keep the baby quiet, Emma has no choice but to let him help relieve her most private pain. But his steady hands and dangerous closeness awaken feelings she should never have. When her husband suddenly video-calls, Dante stays just outside the frame, his hand moving from the ache he was supposed to soothe toward the shadow beneath her skirt. As her husband talks about hunting Dante for a bounty, Emma realizes the real danger is no longer outside the door.
share_text: She begged her husband’s wounded mafia boss to help relieve her blocked milk ducts. Then her husband’s video call lit up.

special_desc: Default
share_text: You need this in a long night.

special_desc: Betrayed housewife Maria’s life is upended when she unexpectedly inherits a vast mafia empire at her grandfather’s funeral, transforming from a dismissed “middle-aged housewife” into the “Godmother” of the St. Clair crime family. As she navigates her new role—seeking peace in a world of violence—she rekindles a forbidden love with Richard, her childhood crush and the family’s trusted advisor. But Richard is secretly the long-lost heir of their greatest rival, torn between blood and loyalty. Forced to publicly oppose each other while secretly allying, they must survive assassinations, family treachery, and their own hearts to expose the true mastermind behind the conflict, end the bloody feud, and claim both power and love.
share_text: Wife to Godmother, love or feud win?

special_desc: Genesis has spent seven years hiding from her Irish mob husband Kiefer and his twin Tadhg. When Tadhg spots her in California, she flees, but Kiefer captures her. During the confrontation, she reveals that Kiefer’s sister Aoife and her friend Laoise pushed her down stairs, causing a miscarriage—while she was pregnant with twins. One twin, Roan, died; the other, Egan, survived and was hidden from Kiefer. Kiefer, shocked, kills a guard who helped cover up the abuse. Genesis escapes but is tracked down with Egan. Kiefer, Tadhg, and his father Lorcan all pursue her, and over time, she forms a polyamorous relationship with the three men. They move to a new estate, and Genesis learns her biological father is Russian mob boss Nazar Sokolov. After Laoise’s rescue attempt and a final confrontation, Genesis kills her enemies and reconciles with her family, ending with new children and a restored bond. Based on Tempting the Mafia Twins by Tatienne Richard on MyFiction.
share_text: A runaway wife confronts her mobster past, uncovers a Russian mafia heritage, and finds love and revenge with three dangerous men.

special_desc: I married mafia heir Vance at twenty and cared for his trauma for five years. He loathed my touch, burned my birthday gift, and let his beloved Iris wander his private study I was banned from. After he was drugged and hurt me cruelly, I begged the godfather for a divorce. When I packed bags and fled to the seaside to grab freedom, Vance broke down without me. He finally spilled his bloody childhood secret and composed a song only for me. Yet he signed divorce papers, gifting me freedom. Will we meet again after I leave everything behind?
share_text: I nursed my traumatized mafia husband for five years while he fawned over another girl—until I ran away, and he traded all his pride just to set me free.

special_desc: Juliet seems like the perfect housewife—calm, composed, and always smiling. But behind that polished exterior hides a woman with a painful past as the long-lost heiress of the notorious Blackstone mafia. She thought she left that life behind when she married Jack, trading power for a chance at a simpler life. But when her charming husband reveals a darker side, plotting to build his own underground empire and leaving her for dead, Juliet barely makes it out alive. Rescued by Simon—her father’s trusted confidant—she fakes her death and comes back as Lila. Gone is the devoted wife. Now, she seeks to tear down Jack’s ambitions piece by piece and save her family’s fading legacy. As she and Simon grow closer romantically, Juliet begins to rediscover her true self, realizing she might be just as dangerous as the world she left behind. In a twisted game of secrets, seduction, and power, Juliet is ready to reclaim what's hers.
share_text: Perfect wife. Mafia heiress. Back from the dead.

special_desc: Athena saves a mafia boss, Dax, but her friend takes the credit. Unexpectedly, Dax becomes Athena's pastry apprentice. Will he uncover Athena's true identity as his savior? What will Athena do when she discovers her pastry apprentice is the undercover kingpin of the underworld?
share_text: Wait, my pastry apprentice is a mafia boss?!

book_title: Claimed by My Boyfriend's Mafia Father
special_desc:
A poor college student. A powerful mafia boss. One unforgettable mistake.
Rosy Walker’s life changes forever when a birthday surprise goes wrong and leads her into the arms of Leon Vittorio — her boyfriend’s father and the most dangerous man in New York.
Now, with secrets, betrayal, and desire pulling them together, there’s no escaping the forbidden love they never saw coming.
share_text: Her boyfriend's father. Her secret. Her ruin.

special_desc: She discovers her mob boss husband's affair and loses one of her twin babies due to his adopted sister's schemes. She reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, she runs into him on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when he drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth. Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. The ruthless mafia boss only wants one thing—to win her love back.Based on Tempting the Mafia Twins by Tatienne Richard on MyFiction.
share_text: On the run from the mob, I ran straight into him and got captured, the boss himself. My husband.

special_desc: Eun-soo gets unexpectedly pregnant due to a medical mix-up. Her initial shock is short-lived when she discovers the father of her unborn child is the ruthless Mafia King, Gio. Though he is a dangerous man who brutally kills his enemies, Eun-soo's heart begins to waver as she sees Gio risk his own life to shield her and their baby from every threat... Will Eun-soo accept Gio as her baby's father and become the Queen of the Mafia Empire?
share_text: I was just an ordinary college student, but suddenly I'm pregnant with the Mafia King's child?!

special_desc: Three years ago, Elena Vance was humiliated on her wedding day when her husband, Tristan, brought his pregnant mistress and forced her to sign divorce papers. That night, Elena disappeared and married Adrian Blackwood, the most feared Mafia Don on the East Coast. Now pregnant with Adrian’s second child, she returns to Edenport, only to be slapped by Tristan, who thinks she is pretending to be Mrs. Blackwood. When Chloe crushes Elena’s black onyx signet ring at a gala, Adrian arrives with their son. One word exposes everything: “Mommy.” Now the city will learn who Elena really is.
share_text: My ex slapped me while holding a sign for “Mrs. Blackwood”—but he had no idea the Mafia Don’s wife he was sent to pick up was me.

special_desc: Sara is forced to marry Noah Dempsey, the blind heir to a struggling family, in place of her stepsister Cathy. As Sara gets to know Noah, she falls in love with him, only to discover that he not only has perfectly good eyesight but also leads a significant property conglomerate. Ultimately, Noah realizes that Sara is the dream girl he's been searching for all along.
share_text: OMG! My Blind Groom is a Billionaire!

special_desc: Elara was chained in a red wedding dress and dragged through the snow, sacrificed by her husband to save his pregnant mistress. He thought the Wolf King would destroy her. He thought she would die forgotten in the North. But seven years ago, Elara saved a starving wolf boy from a fighting pit and gave him a name. Now that boy is Kael, the ruthless Wolf King. When he returns to camp and sees Elara bleeding, burned, and whipped, the entire wolf army watches their king fall to his knees. The bride they mocked is the one woman he would burn the world for.
share_text: My husband sacrificed me to the Wolf King for his pregnant mistress, but he didn’t know the monster he feared was the wolf I once saved.

book_title: My Wolf is the Sun God
special_desc: Sun god Apollo angers Zeus, loses his power, and becomes a dying wolf. To survive, he bites Hecate, triggering an ancient fated-bond contract that shares their life and power. A fallen god and a shattered goddess—reluctant master and servant—struggle through Olympus trials. He regains strength by drinking her blood; she heals with his solar essence. From wolf to wolf-eared youth to human, Apollo evolves as Hecate sacrifices herself to save him. He builds her a sun-wolf pack and storms the underworld. When Hades unleashes the primordial god-king Cronus, Apollo realizes his fall and love for Hecate were all Zeus and the Fates' final move. They are the only answer to Ragnarök.
share_text: God. Wolf. Lover. He fell for her—literally.

book_title: The Bride of the Wolf King
special_desc: Hundreds of years ago, a contest of power and desire caused the Wolf King to lose the woman he loved the most. The Wolf King was in tremendous inconsolable grief and he had sealed up his memory. Then somehow the two met again. The grievances and affairs from the previous life slowly emerged. "And this time, I will kill everyone who obstructs our love. And you shall be my princess, the one and only."
share_text: Reborn lovers, defying fate in a dangerous wolf king's world.

special_desc: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty—only to be betrayed and rejected by her mate. But she’s not one to stay broken for long. When she unexpectedly bonds with a new mate hiding his own secrets, Lia is thrust into a world of power, deception, and second chances. Now, she’s done following the rules. It’s time to reclaim her throne—and make everyone who doubted her regret it!
share_text: You'll regret dumping me once you know who I am!

special_desc:
“Did you get rejected?!” My sister Jade laughs at me. “I knew it! I told you that you would. No one would ever want you. A wolfless. But I’m more surprised that you, of all people, found a fated mate. Kind of unfair if you ask me.”
It stings to hear this. It’s exactly what happened. She was right.
“Well, let’s not let this bring us down.” Mother smiles and claps. “It’s been decided that Jade is to be mated to the fourth wolf prince. ”
Jade smirks. “One of the bastard illegitimate princes, but I’m not complaining.” She smiles with pride. “He’s still a prince.”
The crowd suddenly grow noisy. The princes arrive. 
“Alpha Prince Dorian, the fourth prince, Antonio the fifth, and Emmet the sixth—all of them illegitimate.” All three men wave with broad smiles. Suddenly, another man hurries past them. “That’s Alpha Prince Raphael! Second born to a true royal‑blooded Luna.”
The stunning blond man—his hair lighter than even my mother’s or sister’s—strides forward with an imposing pace. His bright blue eyes gleam beneath the black suit and satin shirt, half‑unbuttoned to reveal the edge of his tattoos. I freeze as his gaze locks onto mine. Time itself seems to stop, because that man… is him. The one who broke my heart. The one who rejected me. The one who shattered our bond. 
My fated mate.
share_text: She has no wolf, no allies, and no idea what she really is — but the ravens do. And people are stunned to find both princes want this wolfless girl.

book_title: My Wolf Rejected Me, So I Chose the Scarred Fox
special_desc: After thirteen years of loving the wolf she rescued from the black market, Emma overhears Brian admit he has always wished he belonged to her beautiful cousin. Crushed by a lifetime of being mocked for her looks and never chosen by anyone, Emma dissolves their bond, leaves him her home, and starts over as a university lecturer in Miami. There, she meets Finn, a scarred fox Beastkin abandoned after escaping a trafficking ring. As Emma gives Finn the kindness she once begged for, he gives her something Brian never could: fierce devotion and the courage to see her own worth. When Brian returns begging for another chance, Emma must choose between the love that wounded her and the one that finally feels like home.
share_text: I freed the wolf who never loved me and found the scarred fox who chose me every day.

special_desc: Mae was mocked as a blind, wolfless Luna until her legendary White Wolf bloodline awakened and restored her sight. The first thing she saw was her mate betraying her with another woman carrying his pup. While he believed she knew nothing, Mae quietly chose to return to Crescent Hollow and claim the throne destined for her. By the time the Alpha realizes he abandoned the future Queen of all wolves, she is already gone. But some mistakes can never be undone.
share_text: He betrayed the blind Luna, never knowing she was the White Wolf Queen destined to rule them all.

book_title: Mom & Dad: I Became the Savage Wolf You Craved
special_desc:
Mom & Dad: I Became the Savage Wolf You Craved tells the story of Elara, heir to the millennium-old White Wolf bloodline of the wolf clan. Gentle and kind by nature, she is despised and abused by her parents—the Alpha and Luna of the clan—who push her to be cruel and bloodthirsty, even casting her into the Blood Moon Coliseum filled with feral mad wolves to “harden” her. Lyra, an adopted human girl, is secretly the daughter of the Dark Witch. She uses dark magic to fake a wolf spirit, seizes Elara’s birthright as heir, and brutally stabs Elara to death in the coliseum with a silver blade.
The Dark Witch turns Elara’s corpse into a mindless undead puppet forced to kill, disguising it as Elara having “evolved into a savage wolf” to win her parents’ approval. Only when the truth is exposed do her parents realize they have driven their only daughter—who alone could save the wolf clan—to her death. In the end, they meet their demise amid remorse and vengeance.
A heartbreaking tale of twisted reversal, it lays bare the despair of being misunderstood, abandoned, and sacrificed by one’s own flesh and blood, and reveals that belated repentance can never heal irreversible wounds.
share_text: Her parents forced a gentle white wolf into brutality; killed and turned into a puppet, their endless remorse arrives too late.

special_desc: Thirteen years ago, a traitorous scheme tore the Bloodwolf Clan apart. The true-born princess, still just a child, was cast out in the wild, losing all memory of who she really was. At nineteen, she awakens the overpowering Progenitor's Power. Returning home, she finds her Mother tortured, her father paralyzed, and the traitors colluding with the enemy to destroy the clan from the inside. Will the true-born princess be able to reclaim her throne and save her people?
share_text: Exiled. Power awakened. Back for her throne!

book_title: After the 330-Pound Fat Wolf Left, the Alpha Went Crazy with Regret
special_desc: Nia is a 300-pound Omega mocked by the entire pack as a disgusting fat wolf. When Alpha Zayne chooses her as his Luna, she believes she has finally been loved. She poisons herself, bleeds for him, tears her own fur to keep him warm, and carries his child. Then she overhears the truth: Zayne only used her as a womb and plans to kill her after the baby is born. Betrayed, abused, and forced through unbearable trials, Nia awakens as a legendary White Wolf. Now she returns under a new name, not for love, but to save the child Zayne killed. The Alpha finally falls in love with her beauty, but the woman who once loved him has already died.
share_text: The 300‑pound fat wolf he scorned turned out to be the White Wolf Saintess.

book_title: My Wolf Guard Chose My Sister, So I Chose the Alpha King
special_desc: Emma spent years protecting Ethan, a supposedly mute werewolf, only to hear him speak when he chose to save her sister from a deadly fire. Reborn on the day their father bought the twin wolf guards, Emma refuses to repeat her mistake. She gives both brothers to Sophia, enters the family empire, and builds the power she was once denied. But when betrayal turns into kidnapping and murder, Emma fakes her death and joins forces with Mason Astor, the ruthless Alpha King and her family’s greatest rival. This time, the abandoned heiress won’t beg to be chosen—she’ll destroy everyone who chose against her.
share_text: I devoted ten years to a mute wolf guard, only to hear him speak as he left me to burn and saved my sister. Reborn before his betrayal, I gave him away—and chose the ruthless Alpha King instead.

special_desc:
Lyra, the heir to the Wolf Clan’s throne, takes on the role of Kai’s “girlfriend” to repay the human boy for saving her life twelve years ago. 
Together, they weather clan conflicts and a manhunt by the Wolf Clan, fall in love, and defeat the villain Sable.
In the end, Lyra is crowned queen, and Kai transforms into a werewolf to protect her. Together, they work to safeguard each other’s worlds.
share_text: She repaid her debt. He became her mate.

special_desc: Alina desperately needs a child with Cade to save her daughter, who needs a cord blood transplant. Misunderstood as a betrayer who once abandoned Cade, she bears the humiliation for her child. The truth, however, is heart-wrenching. As the layers of deception unravel, Cade finally realizes the woman he resented for six years was innocent all along.
share_text: He wanted revenge. She needed a baby.

special_desc: To secure her boyfriend’s future, Gloria pretends to be superficial and breaks up with him. Seven years later, she's forced into an arranged marriage, only to find her fiancé's uncle is her now-successful ex. As old feelings resurface and misunderstandings unravel, the two are drawn back together for a second chance at love.
share_text: The man I left behind...is my fiancé’s uncle!

special_desc: Marry the man of her dreams was supposed to be the key to Ivy Donahue's happily-ever-after. Instead, it was only the start to an endless cycle of misery and heartbreak. But when her husband crosses the ultimate line, Ivy reveals she's not just any housewife—she's a billionaire heiress, and she's going to make him pay.
share_text: There are lines he never should've crossed.

special_desc: After a medical mishap, the virgin Violet Gray becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire stranger, Carter Watts. To provide for the child, they are forced into a hasty marriage. Carter leaves for a business trip and is away for six years, during which Violet raises their son, Patrick, on her own while working at a five-star hotel. Unexpectedly, the hotel is bought out by a mysterious new owner—Carter himself! However, after six years apart, they no longer recognize each other. By chance, Violet discovers that her charming boss, Carter Watts, is actually her long-lost husband...
share_text: I'm a virgin, but I'm pregnant.

special_desc: Despite being newly married, Nicole Lane suffers a heartbreaking betrayal at her husband's hands, leading to the tragic loss of her child. Unable to cope with the pain, she loses her sanity—only to reunite with Liam Holt five years later. After enduring years of cruelty from her former mother-in-law and mistreatment by the household staff, Nicole regains her memories and vows revenge. With Liam's help, she sets a trap for her ex-husband. As they navigate hardships together, love blossoms between them, and Liam paves the way for their future with a heartfelt proposal.
share_text: Betrayal, payback, and a twist they never saw coming—this "fool" isn’t just fighting back, they’re winning with flair and fortune!

book_title: Daddy Left His Baby to Die
special_desc: Careless father leaves toddler in a hot car unattended. Will her mother be able to find her and save her in time?
share_text: Can Mom save daughter trapped in hot car in time?

book_title: My Unborn Baby Called Me Out
special_desc: Rosie Grant died saving the world—and woke up as a fetus in a novel. Her mother? A world-class love fool. Her father? A gold-digging deadbeat. The whole family? Doomed. Rosie panicked. And then her thoughts started leaking out—loud and clear. Her mother heard her. The romance-brain snapped awake. Armed with Rosie's inside intel, the maternal clan united: outsmart the scumbag, crush the scheming mistress. By the time Rosie was born, she and her mother were the most spoiled girls in the Grant family.
share_text: I died a hero. Reborn in a novel. Now I'm saving my family.

book_title: In Love with Dr. Baby Daddy!
special_desc: Fueled by the sting of betrayal from her selfish ex, Jade Lancaster dives headfirst into her surgical residency, determined to prove him wrong. But what she didn't expect was to collide with her resident supervisor in a steaming hot ONS! Introducing Dr. Damon Ford—a renowned surgeon with a ruthless edge and a shocking secret: he's the father of her ex's and Jade's baby daddy!
share_text: You are pregnant, the baby daddy is your boss... your ex's dad!

special_desc: On the same day, two best friends gave birth. Ellen, drowning in poverty, secretly swapped her newborn with her billionaire best friend’s baby, desperate to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she never expected: her friend saw everything and silently switched the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Ellen’s scheme is finally about to pay off, the truth explodes in her face: the daughter she’s tormented and belittled all along… is her own blood.
share_text: Jealousy drove Ellen to swap babies with the CEO, who secretly swapped them back. Eighteen years later…

book_title: Baby’s Sweet Revenge: Mommy, I found My Dream Daddy！
special_desc: In a world where family ties are tested, Flora, a bright young girl, navigates a turbulent home life. Her father, Shawn, belittles her mother, Winnie, over her looks, while engaging in an affair with his sister-in-law, Mandy. Following Winnie's tragic death, Flora's attempt to thwart Shawn and Mandy's wedding leads to her own demise. Yet, destiny intervenes. Reborn, Flora wields her intelligence to liberate her mother from a toxic marriage.
share_text: Will Flora succeed in rewriting their story?

special_desc:
Aurora may seem like an ordinary housewife, but in reality, she is the only daughter of the impossibly powerful Redmond family. On their wedding anniversary, she catches her politician husband, Shawn, cheating with her best friend, Tiffany, in his office. She also learns that her late young daughter was denied her life-saving transplant because of them.

After learning the truth, Aurora contacts her family and decides to leave Shawn. She secretly gets him to uniwttingly sign a divorce agreement. Completely unaware of what’s happening, he continues his endless string of betrayals, practically rubbing her face in his affair.

Aurora endures humiliation and anger. She plots her revenge. She exposes her cheating husband in front of the public at a campaign event, revealing his true nature to all of his supporters. She decides to run against him in the gubernatorial election, not only to end his political career, but to usurp it.
share_text: He robbed me of my daughter. So I robbed him back.

special_desc: Humble baker Everly agrees to flash marry Julian, a single-dad billionaire who needs a stand-in wife to keep custody of his daughter. What begins as a pretend marriage turns into a recipe for love as they figure out their feelings for each other while battling a jealous nemesis, a stalker ex-fiancé and a batshit crazy ex-wife who will do anything to break them up.
share_text: Recipe: yummy billionaire + sweet baker + cute kid

book_title: Flash Marriage to the Wild Billionaire
special_desc: After she supports him through law school, Vicente dumps her. His reason? He found a rich girl to marry! Heartbroken, Abril marries a stranger... only to discover he is the billionaire CEO Cristóbal Noriega!
share_text: You marry a stranger expecting a divorce, but now he won't let you go!

book_title: Twilight Romance: Flash Marriage to Mature Tycoon
special_desc: Ray, a middle-aged businessman who has given up on love. Posing as a construction worker, he enters into a flash marriage with Jocelyn, a woman who has just been kicked out of her house. Their union starts off with a sweet and dreamy honeymoon phase, but their love is interrupted by persistent bullying from the family of Jocelyn's daughter-in-law. After repeatedly saving Jocelyn from disaster, Ray reveals his hidden billionaire identity to her, and the two of them embark on a life of luxury. That's when Ray's ex-wife returns to drive a wedge betwen Ray and Jocelyn, and as Jocelyn prepares to sacrifice herself for the sake of her husband's career, Ray gives her the most romantic of surprises...
share_text: My construction worker hubby is a billionaire!

special_desc: Her fiancé is snatched by her sister, then she flash-marries a trillionaire and gets showered with love!
share_text: Your Mr. Right appears only when the jerk is out of the picture!
book_sub_title: Flash Marriage CEO Spoils Me a Lot

book_title: The Fake Marriage Got Too Real
special_desc: A 3-month trial marriage turns into forever! Billionaire heiress Sophie hides her true talents from her cold fiancé, Alex Prescott. By day, she uses hacking and medical skills to save him; by night, she's the woman of his dreams. When Alex realizes his fiancée is actually his childhood crush, Lola, the contract burns away in this super sweet romance!
share_text: Fake shy fiancée, real trouble! This trial love just turned into forever!

special_desc: Emily's fiance Henry breaks up with her on their wedding day. Pushed by her toxic best friend, Fiona, she agrees to enter a fake marriage with another man, but mistakes William, her mysterious billionaire CEO, for the man she's supposed to marry. After the wedding, William finds out that Emily is one of his employees, while Emily mistakenly believes that William is drowning in debt. William hides his identity till the day of the design competition when Fiona and Henry plot to sabotage Emily.
share_text: What happens when you discover your husband in debt is actually the boss you hate?

book_title: Marriage on Paper, Fire in Heart
special_desc: After Tessa's parents passed away, she lived with her sister. To avoid burdening her sister, she agreed to a blind date with George, the grandson of Madam Vale, whom she had accidentally saved. At their first meeting, George misunderstood Tessa as a gold digger, so he hid his identity as the richest man and the CEO of Vale Group. After marriage, George gradually changed his mind and fell in love. Later, a rival lady from a rich family showed up and tried to steal George. George realized his feelings and pursued Tessa, while Tessa also fell for him. This contract marriage became a true love story.
share_text: Contract marriage, real love.

book_title: A Marriage for Debt, A Heart to Get
special_desc: To save her family, Rita Lane enters a one‑month marriage of convenience with the billionaire, Landon Hopkin. She’s just a temporary wife; he’s just fulfilling a deal. But between late‑night conversations, unexpected dangers, and the return of his childhood sweetheart Fiona Foster, lines begin to blur. When the contract expires, will they walk away—or choose a love that was never part of the agreement?
share_text: She needed his money. He needed a wife. Their contract didn’t include falling in love.

special_desc:
I married the brother of the man I had always loved, not only to get my mind off of him but to prove to him that I could still get along without him! 
I thought I could win his heart someday, but all I got was the news that he was engaged to someone else. And it was only when I was about to get married to his brother that he realized how precious I was. At my wedding, I looked at the man I once loved with mixed emotions. 
"You didn't want it when I was with you, but you preferred to grab it, isn't that bitchy?"
Moreover, his brother who I flash-married turned out to be a billionaire CEO! How surprising...
share_text: The man I flash-married who I flash-married turned out to be a billionaire CEO! How surprising...

special_desc: When Alfred Lane answers a "surrogate wanted" ad to pay for his mother's medical bills, he never imagines he'll walk away married to Claire Sloane, the legendary ice queen CEO in Saltwick. Their contract is simple: he gets paid, she gets an heir. But Alfred's hidden combat skills and mysterious past turn the tables on judgmental relatives and jealous ex. As Claire sees the real man behind the facade, their fake marriage starts to feel dangerously real.
share_text: She needed an heir. He needed cash. Neither expected to fall in love.

special_desc: Philippe Bastien is the heir to one of the wealthiest conglomerates owned by Émile Bastien in Paris. He is used to having the world at his feet and people at his beck and call. Unknown to him, the source of his family's wealth is deeply tied to a society and to a clause that guides its members. It’s stated that as the heir, Philippe would have to marry one of the daughters of his father's business partners and fellow society members, in order to renew their partnership and in turn, preserve their wealth. Ava Dubois, the only daughter of an equally wealthy French businessman, Martin Dubois has always hated the life she was born into. The dislike for excesses, party lifestyle, and intrusion from the paparazzi has made her become a low-key person. She avoids anything that would bring her back to the spotlight so imagine her surprise when she's summoned to fulfill the marriage contract. Ava is irritated by Philippe's image and rich playboy persona but is obligated to marry him to please her father. When Philippe, who never goes for plain-looking ladies, meets Ava, he is taken aback by her simple appearance and wonders how she could be from such a family. Their personalities clash and it becomes clear that their marriage would be anything but rosy except they find a way out or magically fall in love with each other...
share_text: Forced to marry a playboy—she’s his family’s secret weapon.

special_desc: A promise made in their youth has haunted both Lewis and Yasmin for years. Yet they never realize that the "white moonlight" they've been desperately searching for is none other than their own arranged fiancé / fiancée. Determined to find each other, they try every possible scheme to break off their engagement—never suspecting that the person they fake-married just to escape the arrangement… is the very white moonlight they've been longing for all along.
share_text: Flash marriage fake, the heartbeat real.

special_desc: On a snowy night in Northhaven, Sarah is abandoned by her first love, Sean, and reluctantly marries Simon, who has secretly loved her for over a decade. After four years of a cold marriage, with her ex returning, family pressure, and rumors swirling, Sarah discovers the truth: Simon's love for her was always real, and their marriage was his deep, unwavering devotion. As the truth comes to light, she runs into his arms, saying, "For the rest of my life, please guide me."
share_text: What if the one you thought was your heartbreak was always your true love?

book_title: Flash Marriage to My Comatose Wife
special_desc:
Fresh graduate Elliot is crushed under a mountain of overwhelming medical debt after his parents fall seriously ill. When he hits rock bottom, a mysterious elderly woman offers him a million-dollar reward on one condition: Elliot must marry a nearly forty-year-old vegetative woman and work as her psychological caregiver.
Elliot thinks his life is doomed—until he discovers his vegetative wife Elowen is breathtakingly beautiful and the sole heir to the Hastings family fortune.
Fleet upon fleet of luxury cars, an estate spanning tens of thousands of square feet, private jets and yachts… Elliot soon realizes the comatose woman he hastily married is a billionaire tycoon worth hundreds of billions.
As Elliot continues his care and therapy, Elowen finally regains consciousness. She comes face-to-face with the man who pulled her back from the grip of illness.
share_text: He married a vegetable. He found a fortune.

special_desc: After her grandfather's death, she unexpectedly discovers that both her sister and boyfriend betrayed her, taking away the family fortune left by her grandfather. Determined to seek revenge, she decides to get married, only to realize that she married the wrong person. She immediately files for divorce, but her husband disagrees...
share_text: You flash-married for revenge, only to realize that you married the wrong person...

book_title: Lightening Marriage with a Tycoon Husband
special_desc: Professional Ginny was arranged by her grandmother to marry the man she first met, Kesten, who disappeared without a trace after the wedding. Ginny also forgot about getting married and worked hard to get into M Group. A year later, M Group President Allis Miller returned to the United States from Europe. Ginny always thought Allis looked familiar, but couldn't remember where she had seen him. At work, she chanced to discover that Miller and Kesten were the same person?
share_text: Wedding Vows to Workplace Wars. The Miller-Kesten Revelation!

special_desc:
She was a successful businesswoman with a perfect life—until her husband’s mistress, a live-streaming influencer, barged in with the “Anti-Mistress Alliance,” accusing her of being the homewrecker.
Humiliated and enraged, she began to suspect her husband, who denied everything. As her best friend’s suspicious closeness to him came to light, betrayal surrounded her on all sides.
With her husband and his mistresses plotting against her, she decided to fight back. How will this toxic marriage end?
share_text: How does she handle her husband's extramarital affairs and the mistress's cyberbullying?

special_desc: The CEO's Contract Wife:  Love doesn't cost a thing… until it costs you everything. When billionaire CEO Jasper Tate is fired by his own grandfather, he makes a desperate attempt to get his job back. A wife? An heir? No problem, sign a contract and any girl will do. Any girl being Khloe Adams, who is equally desperate because she needs money to save her sister's life. No love, no sex, no strings attached, but when Khloe ends up in Jasper's bed, he realizes that everything written in their contract... was meant to be broken.
share_text: Everything has a price, even your virginity!

special_desc: Daisy Scott wakes up as the stand-in villainess in a short drama. Her role? Pretend to be the first love of her boss, Spencer Sutton. But Daisy isn't interested in drama—she's here for the paycheck. She happily plays matchmaker between Spencer and his real love, Vivian Winters, while pocketing his cash. Her plan goes off the rails when mysterious heir Liam Lawrence shows up with a magical blood ring that declares Daisy his fated one.
share_text: She came for the paycheck. She left with two billionaires.

book_title: Contract Love with My Fiancé's Wheelchair Uncle
special_desc: On the eve of her engagement, her family went bankrupt, and her fiancé called off the wedding! Mocked by everyone, she mustered the courage to marry a wheelchair-bound billionaire to fulfill her grandmother's wish. Little did she know, the rumors were false! The billionaire's disability was all a facade!
share_text: She marries a wheelchair billionaire, only to discover it's all an act. And he spoils her!

special_desc: To save her daughter, Harper Reed marries Klaus Wolfe—New York's most feared mafia godfather—in her stepsister's place. On the wedding day, he sees right through her and calls her a gold digger. He gives her one choice: jump into a shark pool, or watch her whole family die. Then she jumps without hesitation. That shatters his frozen heart. But she finds out that—this marriage is way worse than death. Lydia deeply hates her. Uncle Richard wants the Don's chair. And "Black Fox" is dragging everyone to hell...
share_text: Married to the devil. Still burning in hell.

book_title: Contract Wife Is a Drama Queen
special_desc: Adrian, unhappy with his family's arranged marriage plans, hires Chloe, a spirited pig butcher, to be his contract bride. Chloe accepts the role for financial gain, skillfully navigating challenges and adversaries. As they grow closer, hidden truths about Adrian's past and Chloe's true identity emerge. Amidst the revelations, they find themselves falling in love, their destinies intertwined by fate.
share_text: He hires a wild-hearted butcher, and destiny leads them to love.

book_title: Contract Wife: Savage Stepmom Rules the Billionaire Empire
special_desc:
Tess Miller, an MIT genius and tech partner, agrees to a $10-million-a-year contract marriage with Garrick Davenport—the head of a hundred-billion-dollar empire. Her sole mandate: take full control of his three notoriously rebellious, spoiled children.
Instead of trying to win them over with meek affection, Tess launches a high-IQ, savage takeover. She conditions the chaotic youngest son, cuts off the predatory parasites preying on the teenage daughter, and intellectually crushes the arrogant eldest heir using advanced options hedging formulas scribbled on scratch paper. When the children’s glamorous ex-wife mother tries to swoop back in and reclaim her place, she discovers that her former children now loyally stand behind their fierce, unstoppable stepmother.
share_text: Hired on a $10M contract, an MIT genius uses Wall Street options formulas and mind games to tame three billionaire brats into straight-A elite students.

special_desc: Based on novel by Sierra Simone... When Isolde Laurence is pressured by her father to kill her own husband, Mark Trevena, she chooses to protect him instead. But when Mark overhears her father's orders, he believes she still intends to murder him. A misunderstanding destroys a whirlwind romance as Mark, a BDSM dom, puts Isolde through a world of pain and punishment, that not even her bodyguard, Tristan Thomas, can save her from. In this heart-breaking conclusion of the Salt Kiss trilogy, what will Mark do when he realizes he's hurt the one's he loved... and how far will he go to get them back?
share_text: She chose love and he chose punishment.

special_desc: She sold herself to save her father. The heir who'd loved her for years took her as his contract lover. He thought she was a gold‑digger. She fell for him anyway. When she got pregnant, he was about to marry another. Threats, lies, and his secret protection pushed her away. Nine years later, their child reunites them. He uncovers the truth, clears every misunderstanding, and finally claims the family he lost.
share_text: Contract lover. Secret baby. Nine years to get her back.

special_desc: On his twenty-second birthday, Nick is dying from a cursed underworld mark. His late guardian leaves him one chance: offer a silver coin to the “Queen of the Underworld.” But the one who answers is Hades himself, a silver-haired god who seals Nick’s life with a black wedding ring. Every time Hades saves him, their marriage contract grows deeper—and Nick becomes harder to let go. When a fallen priest kidnaps Nick to force Hades to open the Underworld Gate, Nick must choose: escape the god who owns his heartbeat, or claim him as an equal.
share_text: On his 22nd birthday, he begged the Underworld Queen for salvation—but Hades came instead, placing a wedding ring on his finger: “Every time I save you, you belong to me more.”

special_desc: Eli Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Eli freedom– but on one condition:  Eli must marry his granddaughter, Christine Parrish, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Eli transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine  ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Eli starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. Then, when Christine's old flame reenters the picture, Eli's heart is completely shattered. Now, Eli is faced with a tough decision– should he stay by Christine's side once the final wish is granted, or is it time to for him to divorce Christine and finally live his own life?
share_text: I was married to the magic genie, but I lost him.

special_desc:
Blood contract is an enthralling series that chronicles the captivating journey of Rosy, who after losing her job and her sense of purpose, meets Sam, a wealthy vampire who proposes to hire her as his contract bride. Although Rosy feels intimidated by Sam's dark world, she takes the offer, thinking that it could be her only chance to make something of her life.
As Rosy navigates her new position as a contract bride, she becomes increasingly aware of the dangerous and enigmatic world of vampires, as well as the ongoing power struggle between Sam and his younger brother, Ken. The competition is centered on who deserves to inherit their family's enterprise after their father's death – a ruthless and cunning vampire leader.
share_text: Would you marry a vampire to escape your meaningless life?

book_title: My Contract Husband Is a Dragon
special_desc:
Three months ago, at the Imperial Midsummer Ball, seamstress Sera Bennett caught her fiancé Michael and her fake friend Laura cheating. Michael, soon to be a duke's guardsman, sneered that she was just a ""lowly sewing girl"" unworthy of his rising status. She slapped him and fled, only to crash into the cold, noble embrace of Duke Alexander Drake, the empire's guardian and Michael's ultimate patron.
Burning with rage, Sera seduced him that very night. After one night, he handed her not gold, but a church‑blessed marriage contract. She assumed it was a deal: she'd gain a duchess's power to crush her betrayers, while he seemed to want her body. One year, then they'd part.
What Sera never knew: Alex is the last ancient black dragon, sealed for centuries. Her kiss is the only cure for his volatile dragon power, and the blood pact binds their souls forever. Married life reveals his strange fevers and odd behavior… and their one‑year agreement becomes anything but simple."
share_text: She thought it was a deal. He made it an eternal bond.

special_desc: Jennifer Sullivan, a lawyer, becomes a spy for Isaac Marks in order to save her sister.
