In the midst of love, hate and conspiracy, she gradually uncovers the truth of the arson case, and when the murderer is finally caught and Isaac reforms, Jennifer decides to let go of her past and make a fresh start with Isaac.
share_text: Lawyer turned spy, love ignites in deadly secrets.

book_title: Contracted CEO Husband Regrets On Divorce Eve
special_desc: Two years ago, we entered into a marriage contract. For two years, we never met each other. Just when we were about to divorce, we ended up having relations. And he doesn't even remember that the person he had a one-night stand with is me! Now, he wants to divorce me. But knowing the truth, he regrets it.
share_text: Two years of marriage, I never met my husband. Right before divorce, we had a fling...

special_desc: When the fate of a business marriage seems inevitable, Emma Watson, the heiress of the Watson family, takes on an internship at Anderson Corporation. Meanwhile, Ethan Anderson, the heir of the Anderson family, steps in as the new CEO. Both hide their true identities while evaluating each other, but they unexpectedly fall in love at first sight. However, things take an unexpected turn when someone else mistakenly claims Emma’s identity, and she mistakenly believes another man is her “fiancé.” Determined, both Emma and Ethan set out to break off their "engagements" with their so-called "fiancés." Will they ever realize that the person they're searching for has been right in front of them all along?
share_text: Strangers as fiances, fated to fall in love under different identities.

special_desc: Wealthy heiress Audrey Hayes is forced into an engagement with trust fund playboy Logan Vance, but her true crush is her fiance's Uncle Dominic, the aloof CEO Dominic Vance. To break the engagement and pursue true love, Audrey sets a series of traps: hiring someone to seduce Logan, faking evidence of his cheating, and even pretending to be drunk to pounce on Dominic. During their hilarious romantic tug-of-war, Dominic sees through her schemes but still falls for her. Ultimately, Audrey successfully breaks off the engagement and gets Dominic to propose publicly, managing to turn the tables from the future niece-in-law into Aunt Audrey.
share_text: Can a secret crush on Uncle Dominic succeed?

special_desc: A group of sexy singles move in together with one unforgettable goal: uncover their secret soulmate. Each person has a hidden match living alongside them, but finding true love isn't easy when secrets, temptations, and sexy challenges are around every corner. Will our singles recognize true, fated love—or choose the wrong heart?
share_text: Could you suss out your secret soulmate?

special_desc: A deaf heiress regains her hearing just in time to discover the people closest to her plotting against her. Keeping her recovery a secret, she plays a dangerous game of deception against those who believe her disability makes her weak. As she investigates suspicious events from her past, she must carefully navigate a web of betrayal while pretending not to hear the conspiracies unfolding around her in order to bring those who wronged her to justice.
share_text: Deafness was her weapon all along.

book_title: My Secret Son with the Billionaire
special_desc: Six‑year‑old Noah suffers from serious congenital heart disease. His mother Luna crashes her stepsister Melissa’s engagement party to seek medical funds, striking a three‑month courtship deal with powerful billionaire Ethan. Unbeknownst to Ethan, Noah is his biological son from a drugged one‑night encounter years before. Melissa frames Luna and forges DNA reports to seize the Monroe family fortune. After countless dangers, schemes and misunderstandings, the truth surfaces. Luna drops her guard, and the whole family finally gains true happiness.
share_text: He thought he was saving a stranger’s child. He was saving his own.

book_title: My Boss Is My Secret Husband
special_desc: To save her grandfather, jewelry designer Elena enters a fake marriage with a stranger, CEO Cedric. Two years later, she joins his company as his assistant, but they don't recognize each other, sparking a sweet comedy of "my boss is my husband." Facing schemes from a jealous colleague, Elena and Cedric clash and connect in the workplace. As misunderstandings and plots unravel, they are shocked to discover their legal spouse is their destined true love.
share_text: Office romance? Try married without knowing it.

special_desc: Emma stood by Spencer through his darkest days. But he abandoned her in the wilderness on her birthday just for a call from his first love. Emma met two drunk punks and almost got assaulted by them. Luckily, she was saved by Joshua. Calling off the wedding, Emma flash married Joshua, Riverton's newly returned billionaire heir. Little did she know, Joshua has harbored a secret crush on her for eight years and is ready to spoil her endlessly.
share_text: I dumped my fiancé for a billionaire! Ex begs for mercy!

book_title: The Double Life of My Secret Secretary
special_desc: Her parents forced her into a flash marriage with a stranger who was a CEO, so she fled abroad to escape. After returning home, to avoid her mother's nagging, she disguised herself as a man and became her friend's brother's personal assistant. She then discovered that her boss was the man she had a one-night stand with on her first day back—and he was also her flash-marriage husband whom she had never met!
share_text: What? My boss is actually the guy I had a one-night stand with, and he's also my flash-marriage husband whom I've never met?

special_desc: In her past life, Harper Prescott was killed by her parents and sister after helping them win the family inheritance. Reborn, she decides to get a new dad—her deadbeat uncle! But Gramps can hear her every thought. Guided by her inner voice, Richard Prescott finally sees his eldest son's worth and exposes the ruthless hypocrisy of his second son, Derek Prescott. This time, Harper will get her happily ever after!
share_text: New Dad! Gramps reads minds to crush scum!

special_desc: Violet, desperate to pay for her father’s surgery, decides to sell her virginity, but the good doctor she calls is determined to pull her back from the edge. However, as the two share a heated, unforgettable night, Dax finds himself hooked on Violet, despite thinking she’s just another gold-digger. When their darkest secrets are laid bare, will their fragile connection survive?
share_text: Strip down, Doctor's orders!

book_title: Doctor, Sleep with Me, Heal My Heart
special_desc: Shanley buries her fiancé's affair behind a forced smile. But sleepless nights bring her to Simon, a healer who sees through her. Under his gentle guidance, she finds her voice. On the day she was supposed to say "I do," she says "I'm done" instead. And when their families' history comes to light, in the clinic where she first asked for help, he proposed to her.
share_text: Five years with the wrong man. One night with the right doctor.

book_title: My Dear Doctor, Please Be Gentle with Me
special_desc:
Coerced by her evil stepsister, a desperate girl spends one night with a cold wealthy doctor.
Filled with misunderstandings, schemes and cruel bullying, love hides behind endless hardships.
He chooses prison over a forced marriage.
She arrives in a wedding dress, defends him in court, and marries him against all odds.
share_text: Evil plots, prison escape, and a wedding dress in court—love's wild ride!

special_desc: Medical student James Madden accidentally gains X-ray vision. After being framed, he uses his new powers to exact swift revenge on his enemies. He then saves a billionaire's daughter, outshines top medical experts, and strikes it rich by finding rare antiques and playing the stock market.
share_text: X-ray vision helps him crush enemies and get rich.

special_desc: After losing her family and her pack, pre-med student, Yara, wants to leave the wolf world behind and live as a normal college girl. But when she stumbles across Alpha Warren, a strong, sexy pack leader and saves his life, he’s hellbent on proving to her she belongs at his side. Convinced they’re fated mates, Warren takes Yara back to his pack to make her queen. When he crowns her pack doctor, Yara goes from shy student to leading Luna, and slowly falls for the Alpha who loves her as she is.
share_text: Will a pack doctor choose love or leave her Alpha?

book_title: Forbidden Night: The Billionaire Wolf and His Private Doctor
special_desc:
Chloe once came from a prominent medical clan, until misfortune struck her family.
Her father was framed and passed away, leaving her severely ill mother in urgent need of costly medical expenses.
She took a high-paying confidential role as a full-time private doctor to make ends meet.
 
Her mysterious boss is young billionaire Ethan, who suffers a rare moon-induced poison.
The toxin causes him to lose sanity and turn into a wild wolf during every full moon.
 
The blood moon night bound them together in passion. Ethan noticed her distinctive heart-shaped birthmark, and recognized the long-lost girl he had been seeking all along.
 
Ethan became overly protective of Chloe afterwards. They weathered misunderstandings, dangers and abduction ordeals together.
Side by side, they took down corporate enemies, uncovered illegal organ trafficking crimes, and cleared her father’s tarnished reputation.
Eventually, Ethan secured full control of his family empire, and Chloe established herself as a world-class professional surgeon.
share_text: He's a cursed billionaire. She's his one cure—and his lost girl.

special_desc: Medical student James Madden accidentally gains X-ray vision. After being framed, he uses his new powers to exact swift revenge on his enemies. He then saves a billionaire's daughter, outshines top medical experts, and strikes it rich by finding rare antiques and playing the stock market.
share_text: X-ray vision helps him crush enemies and get rich.

book_title: I'm the Doctor You Never Should Have Fired
special_desc: Three years ago, Chloe won the national clinical skills championship but chose frontline medicine over fame. When she saves a billionaire's wife and her baby, a rival doctor steals the credit, and a corrupt director fires Chloe. After the truth is exposed, Chloe returns to save the patient and brings her betrayers to justice. Vindicated at last, she leads a national emergency-care initiative and earns the country's highest medical honor.
share_text: They stole her credit. Now she's back to expose them all!

book_title: Your Highness, Your Family Doctor Is Actually a Girl!
special_desc: A modern female doctor unexpectedly travels back in time to become Elara, second daughter of the disgraced Blair family. To save her family, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the close servant of the war god, Noah Croft. Using her talents and modern medical knowledge, Elara repeatedly saves lives in times of crisis. Noah develops feelings for her but struggles with his perception of her gender until her true identity is revealed. Then, together, they overcome challenges and forge a magical romance that transcends time.
share_text: In a world where time and identity are fluid, love finds a way to bridge the impossible.

special_desc:
After years of devotedly caring for her family, she was met with relentless ingratitude from her husband and son—who even brazenly vowed to form a "real family" with a glamorous actress. Heartbroken by their betrayal, fate intervened when she saved the life of an influential industry titan during a medical emergency. As a skilled doctor, she earned both his admiration and steadfast support, emboldening her to divorce her toxic marriage.
Guided by the mogul’s mentorship, she reclaimed her identity and blossomed into her own spotlight: excelling in her medical career, radiating confidence, and crafting a life of purpose. Meanwhile, the delusional father-son duo, who’d believed their fantasy would thrive, soon drowned in regret—one desperately chasing redemption as a son, the other pleading for a second chance as a husband, both left to mourn the irreplaceable woman they’d taken for granted.
share_text: Meanwhile, the delusional father-son duo, who’d believed their fantasy would thrive, soon drowned in regret...

book_title: Watch Out! She's a Mastermind Heiress
special_desc: After growing up in the countryside, 21-year-old Isabella Patton is sent back to her wealthy birth family. Before long, she becomes acquainted with the smoldering (and much older) Oliver Bates, who begins to relentlessly pursue her, oblivious to the fact that she is his fiancée. Meanwhile, Isabella's cousin Eliza, who was raised by the Patton family in her place, is on a desperate mission to turn the whole family against her for good. Unluckily for Eliza, Isabella is a hotshot genius with unparalleled talent in the medical and tech fields, and is able to outduel Eliza at every turn. As Isabella's unique skills are revealed, she wins the support of her five brothers and parents, becoming the crown jewel of the Patton family while always remaining just out of Oliver's grasp.
share_text: He doesn't know he's engaged to a mafia scientist.

book_title: Heal the CEO: Little Doctor's Journey
special_desc: Destined to be broke, Faye, a gifted mountain healer, saves the life of Mrs. Hayes, who welcomes her into the most powerful family in town. She calls the cold, wheelchair-bound billionaire Jackson Hayes "Dad" and sets out to heal his legs and lift a dark curse. But when a jade pendant falls from her pocket, identical to Jackson's own, a long-buried secret threatens to change everything.
share_text: Little magic doctor has a CEO Dad?!

special_desc: Rowan's life was shattered when he witnessed his mother's brutal murder, leaving him tormented by vengeance. Yet, his quest for justice is stalled by his master, who holds the key to his enemy's identity. The price? Rowan must honor an ancient marriage contract, forcing him to choose between love and revenge.
share_text: Haunted by his mother's death, his heart burns with a desire for justice!

special_desc: Spencer, a modern young man, is thrust into a world of beast taming. Betrayed by his girlfriend and left with a failed contract, he unexpectedly awakens a pay-to-win system. Alongside his cousin, a fellow time-traveler Black Dragon, Spencer captures SSS-tier dragons, topples his enemies, destroys the Shaw clan, and puts an end to rampaging beasts. From powerless outcast to unstoppable dragon master, his rise is as fierce as it is legendary.
share_text: From loser to dragon master, revenge has never been this epic!

book_title: My Fireplace Ships to Dragon Realm
special_desc: Wealthy heiress Emily is hunted down by her relatives over her massive inheritance. She flees to her family’s rural farm for shelter, only to accidentally discover that their fireplace connects to a dragon‑ruled otherworld. She keeps sending modern supplies to this realm, aiding Kael, the metal dragon lord, in protecting his people and homeland. To the dragons, she becomes the "Dragon God". From firewood and medicine to modern weaponry, she reshapes the dragon‑race war step by step — and rewrites her own destiny.
share_text: A fireplace, a dragon lord, and a woman who became their god.

special_desc: Betrayed by his ex-wife, stripped of everything he owned, and left with a daughter dying of leukemia—Liam Blackwood has hit rock bottom. But just when all hope seems lost, an ancient drake pendant awakens the power within him. Rising from the ashes as the Drake Heir, he heals the incurable with a single touch, and shatters bones with a single step. Now, armed with divine medical skill, unmatched martial prowess, and a burning thirst for vengeance, Liam returns to Everett City—not to beg, but to bury.
share_text: Arising from the abyss, the dragon leaves no enemy standing.

book_title: Reborn to Rule the Sky with My Dragon
special_desc:
Briar gave everything to her elite dragon flight and her fiancé, Silas. Her reward? Betrayal. They mocked her unawakened dragon as a useless runt, stripped her of her rank, and left her to die.
But death didn't take.
Reborn back to a few days ago, Briar turns her back on her toxic ex. While they laugh at her "weak" dragon, Briar is ready to unleash a mythical power unseen for centuries. When the skies clash, Silas will realize too late: they didn't just discard a useless teammate—they threw away the goddess of victory.
share_text: Second chance: my dragon and I reclaim victory.

special_desc: The ancient dragon fell into slumber protecting humanity. A prophecy promised a new Dragon Lord, marked by a dragon sign, would awaken it. The world forgot—only a wandering bard still searched. William, a magic-less stable hand, lost everything to Baron Charlie. Then an accident awakened a dragon egg, and his hidden power. Now he must survive trials, claim the dragon, defy nobles, and rescue the girl he loves. The lost king rises.
share_text: My dragon, my best partner.

special_desc: Spencer, a modern young man, is thrust into a world of beast taming. Betrayed by his girlfriend and left with a failed contract, he unexpectedly awakens a pay-to-win system. Alongside his cousin, a fellow time-traveler Black Dragon, Spencer captures SSS-tier dragons, topples his enemies, destroys the Shaw clan, and puts an end to rampaging beasts. From powerless outcast to unstoppable dragon master, his rise is as fierce as it is legendary.
share_text: From loser to dragon master, revenge has never been this epic!

special_desc:
For ten years, Princess Isolde of Viridia loved Temple Knight Captain Leon wholeheartedly—until she discovered his secret affair with her younger sister Eileen. Heartbroken and disillusioned, she took Eileen’s place as the realm’s sacrifice to the ferocious dragon plaguing the kingdom.
In the dragon’s desolate territory, Isolde uncovered the truth: the thousand-year-old dragon Kalen, branded as a cruel tyrant, is merely a gentle, lonely being trapped in eternal solitude. The two wounded souls comfort and heal each other, falling into a forbidden love that transcends mortal and mythical boundaries.
Leon soon regrets his betrayal and rushes to plead for Isolde’s mercy, only to be firmly rejected. Eileen’s malicious schemes are eventually exposed, and she receives due punishment for her treachery.
Letting go of her painful past, Isolde chooses to stay by Kalen’s side. The two lovers rebuild the barren dragon realm, breathing new vitality into the long-desolate land.
share_text: She was sent to die for a dragon. She fell in love with him instead.

book_title: Sister Stole My Mate, I Got the Dragon King
special_desc: At their mate-selection ceremony, Grant rejects Mara in front of both tribes and gives her place to her crying younger sister. He swears it is only temporary. He has forgotten one thing: Mara turns twenty-two in three days. Under tribal law, an unmated woman loses her right to choose, and Mara has already been assigned to the dying Dragon King. Grant expects her father to stop it. Mara accepts the decree. Three days later, as Grant comes to bond with Brenna, one hundred dragon guards arrive at the Hale gates to escort Mara away as their future queen.
share_text: He rejected Mara to save her sister. Then the Dragon Court claimed its queen.

book_title: Betrayed, Broken, But Crowned the Dragon King's Queen
special_desc: Aurora, a descendant of the White King, is betrayed by her ex-husband Darian and offered as a tribute to Drake, the Black King. The resonance of their ancient dragon blood awakens unexpectedly, pulling her into the power vortex of the Nibelungen realm. Chloe, the arrogant Water Dragon Princess, repeatedly plots against and humiliates her, while Xavier, a half-blood black dragon, secretly orchestrates a rebellion to seize the throne. Through her tangled bond with Drake, Aurora transforms from a downtrodden abandoned wife into the rightful White King wielder of the Purifying Flame. In the end, the two join forces to crush the rebellion, uncover the truth of their bloodlines, affirm their love, and ascend the twin thrones together.
share_text: Their blood resonated. She rose from tribute to queen.

special_desc: The princess who conquered a kingdom for her brother retired to the countryside with her daughter. Eighteen years later, on her daughter's wedding day, she discovers the emperor has given her daughter's betrothed—a top scholar—to another woman, and the groom's mother wants her daughter as a concubine. Enraged, she storms back to the capital, determined to get justice—even if it means hanging the emperor upside down and whipping him.
share_text: Giving away my son-in-law? The princess flips the table!

special_desc:
Vera and Lucas enter a marriage of convenience—a contract built on duty, inheritance, and cold practicality. Lucas believes their relationship is nothing more than a transaction. Vera, however, slowly falls for him through their daily life together. At a public banquet, Lucas announces important news but shines the spotlight on another woman, leaving Vera heartbroken.

Then an accident steals Vera’s memory. As she rebuilds her life, her true identity emerges: she is the long-lost heiress of the Costa family, one of the world’s most powerful mafia clans. With a new identity and formidable background, Vera stops waiting for love and takes control of her own life.

Meanwhile, Lucas finally realizes what he lost and begins searching for the wife he neglected. When they meet again, old misunderstandings, hidden truths, and family conflicts surface. Faced with status differences, emotional wounds, and outside obstacles, Lucas must earn Vera’s trust again—while Vera must choose between love, family duty, and her own growth.
share_text: Contract wife. Mafia heiress. She lost her memory, but not her destiny.

special_desc: When a drifter helps her run away from a dangerous groom, Riley Jones thinks she’s found her Prince Charming.  But what Riley doesn’t know is her protector actually IS a prince – and it isn’t fate that brought them together.  Prince Xander has deliberately sought Riley out because she is the key to saving his troubled kingdom.
share_text: What do a down-on-her-luck waitress and snobbish prince have in common…love.

book_title: So close, yet so far the stolen princess
special_desc: On the day of her birth, Princess Olivia of the Magic Empire was swapped by her ambitious aunt Sirena, who branded her with a dark magic seal to suppress her powers, leaving her a powerless "lowly bastard." For eight years, she was beaten and tortured by her false mother, bullied mercilessly by the false princess Julianna, and even forced to kneel and eat from a dog bowl at the royal banquet—while her real mother, the Queen, and her brother, the Crown Prince, remained unaware, though they were so close. On the eve of the Bloodstone Ceremony, which would decide the fate of the empire, Sirena cut open her chest to extract her pure blood. Dying, the 8-year-old girl, desperate to keep her promise to her brother that she "must come," broke her own fingers to free herself from chains, walked barefoot across molten rock, and pushed open the palace doors covered in blood. As she was dragged away, her collar tore, and her 11-year-old brother instantly recognized the Stardust mark on her chest—the truth was revealed. Her mother awakened in fury, and the divine pure blood returned in glory. The true heir reclaimed the throne, and the villains faced judgment.
share_text: One mark. One recognition. One throne reclaimed.

special_desc:
Princess Ella, a mermaid, possesses the mystical power to sense the Black Tide, yet the royal family regards her merely as a tool to guard their secrets. She is deeply in love with her fiancé Cedric and once sacrificed her life to save him. But on the eve of their wedding, she discovers Cedric has been misled by her younger sister Vivian. Not only does he betray her, but Vivian also pushes Ella into the deadly Black Tide.
Trapped in mortal peril, Ella is rescued by Ronan, the Black‑Sailed Pirate King. This man, whom she once saved by chance, takes her away from the cold royal palace and grants her freedom for the very first time. As the two venture deep into the Black Tide to uncover the truth, Ella stumbles upon a staggering conspiracy concealed by the mermaid royal family to manipulate the seas.
Plagued with regret after losing Ella, Cedric is too late. The mermaid princess who was once sacrificed has fully awakened. She commands the Black Tide, leads the pirate fleet, and exposes the royal family’s lies. From a manipulated pawn, she rises to become the Queen of the Black Tide who holds the ocean’s fate in her hands.
share_text: From mermaid princess to pirate queen—she holds the ocean's fate.

book_title: You Dumped Me, I Got a Princess
special_desc: For three years, he played the meek live-in husband, hiding his true identity. Then Vanessa's first love returned, and she coldly kicked him out. The moment the divorce was signed, Ethan York reclaimed his birthright – the legendary heir of the York dynasty. Now South Province bosses bow, miracle doctors respect him, and the capital's elite answer to him. Vanessa begs on her knees. He walks away. And when he finally finds his match in the capital's most untouchable princess? The whole city watches her weep.
share_text: Dump a dragon, beg the dragon – too late, sweetheart.

special_desc: Her boyfriend chose a maid's daughter. Her father locked her in a mental ward. Her family let her die. Now Vivienne Lancaster is reborn, and she's coming for what's hers and every single person who ever betrayed her.
share_text: The maid's daughter stole her life. Now she's taking it back!

special_desc: Natalie left everything behind to start a new life in the woods, until Alpha Jayce's invasion led to both her parents' deaths. Upon returning, Natalie learns that this new Alpha isn't who he seemed, and everything she knew about herself has been a lie. Can she trust this dangerous stranger when she can't even trust herself?
share_text: Everything you knew about yourself was a lie...anchor your heart or prepare to die.

special_desc: After their fellow veteran's apparent death, hard-bitten Nick Gallo and two other brothers-in-arms join forces in Las Vegas to protect the man’s wife and daughter from a savage local mob. Nick starts falling in love with the family, but his relationship is thrown into chaos after a shocking return.
share_text: In this squad, you’re family.

special_desc: Born with the sealed bloodline of Hades, Lia Thorne is raised as the lost daughter of the wealthy Lancaster family. But when her return exposes their crimes and shatters their "lucky" adopted daughter Ava's perfect life, Lia is branded a curse. On her twelfth birthday, her parents drug her and leave her at Black Rose Manor, the most feared mafia estate in Black Bay. They expect her to die. Instead, mafia queen Veronica Knight and executioner Damian Wolf protect her as their little princess. As enemies close in, Lia's hidden power awakens, turning every betrayal into deadly karma.
share_text: She was sacrificed to the mafia as a curse, but the girl they abandoned is Hades' lost daughter.

special_desc: Elaine Kelly donated her marrow to save her neglecting father James Chapman, but became too ill and died full of regrets. She was reborn and was determined to take control of her own fate this time. Elaine attended an audition and landed the leading role, beating her half-sister Rachel. Conflict ensued at the audition, leading Elaine to want to leave her dad to live with her new manager, Tracy Ford. It was only then that James started to show more concern towards Elaine. The pair gradually resolved past misunderstandings and started their new happy life.
share_text: If I could live my life over, I wouldn't want a dad like him.

special_desc: Gloria Cooley is reborn on the day she was married to Alistair Payne. In her past life, she managed to marry him, only to earn his hatred and witness her country fall. This time, she chooses to marry Alvin Walsh, the King of Sabulon, and finds that the King falls in love with her. Meanwhile, Alistair realizes too late that he has always loved her.
share_text: She gives up love to save her country and rewrites her destiny.

special_desc: Betrayed by her sister and fiancé, modern doctor Juliana Collins is forced to marry Prince Aubrey—a crippled war hero despised by the emperor. Armed with a secret medical system, she navigates deadly court conspiracies, heals the wounded, and uncovers the truth behind her mother's murder. As she fights for survival, she transforms from pawn to power—winning Aubrey's heart and threatening the throne itself.
share_text: She was forced to marry a crippled prince, but she'll cure him and rule the court.

book_title: The Princess Who Heard My Secrets
special_desc: Julian Hart was reincarnated into ancient times with a system. His mission? Save the kingdom. His response? Hard pass. He wanted nothing more than to lounge around and do nothing. So the system improvised. Instead of forcing Julian to act, it gave the princesses around him extraordinary abilities—including the power to hear his every thought. Now Julian can't escape. He ends up solving impossible math problems, outsmarting traitors, and accidentally becoming the realm's most unlikely hero...
share_text: Truth is, a man who wants nothing can still end up with everything.

special_desc: Qianrin borders are under attack. Gretta Ely, heartbroken by Crown Prince Hades Maverick's intention to wed someone else, requests a diplomatic marriage decree. Hesitated, the emperor still appoints her as Princess of Qianrin. She will marry in seven days. Meanwhile, the crown prince, unaware of her decision, remains confident that his childhood sweetheart would never leave him.
share_text: If love no longer exists, she'll walk away.

special_desc: Emma and Liam shared a magical night together that ended abruptly when Liam left the next morning without a explanation. Six months later, they get reunited at Emma's sister's wedding where Liam is the best man. As their unsolved feelings come rushing back, Emma decides to fake date Liam for the weekend to get her ex to leave her alone.
share_text: Fake date for the weekend? What could go wrong?

special_desc: Jacob, an immortal, has been searching for Princess Prisca's reincarnation for 1,000 years. In South City, he finds Sylvia, a CEO resembling Prisca, and becomes her driver to protect her. But is she really his love?
share_text: 1,000 years, one love, same person?

special_desc: Adeline Rhodes is diagnosed with stage four kidney cancer and has months to live. Her husband, Blake Rhodes, seems preoccupied with her half-sister Rebecca, whom she constantly has to donate blood to. Blake mistakes Adeline for a calculating gold-digger, and she thinks he’s never loved her. All of this changes when Blake finds out Adeline’s dying, but it might be too late for him to tell her that it was her that he loved all this time.
share_text: Before I go...will you kiss me one last time?

special_desc: On the night of her engagement, Charlotte discovers her fiancé William cheating with her best friend. Just as her world collapses, rising hockey star Ryan unexpectedly steps into her life and becomes the only person willing to protect her.But their connection soon pulls them into something far more dangerous than heartbreak. After Ryan is brutally injured during a suspicious game, Charlotte uncovers a web of power, money, and manipulation tied to her family fortune.
share_text: He was supposed to be her revenge. Turns out, he's the target.

special_desc: On the eve of her engagement, the female lead escapes her terrifying family and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire male lead. The grand hotel where she works is also acquired by him as he pursues her relentlessly. Though she only wants to work hard and prove her own worth, the man’s persistence wears her down. In the end, she not only achieves success at the hotel through her own efforts but is also pampered beyond measure by the man.
share_text: The girl from the small town reaps success and love.

special_desc: Jacob, an immortal, has been searching for Princess Prisca's reincarnation for 1,000 years. In South City, he finds Sylvia, a CEO resembling Prisca, and becomes her driver to protect her. But is she really his love?
share_text: 1,000 years, one love, same person?

special_desc: When Sophia sets out to find her missing twin sister, Tina, the trail leads her to The Red Veil, an elite vampire nightclub ruled by the ruthless Von Drák family. As she digs deeper into its dark, seductive world, Sophia discovers a chilling prophecy, a forbidden romance, and a supernatural war that could consume them all.
share_text: In a world ruled by vampires, Sophia’s quest for her missing sister uncovers forbidden romance and a prophecy powerful enough to ignite an eternal war between darkness and light.

special_desc: For centuries, the most powerful vampires, the Tepes family and the Velda family have remained an alliance which, if broken, could send the world into chaos like never before. The alliance is threatened by a seemingly normal human girl Sammantha Evans, a waitress at Club Dracula owned by the powerful Alarik Tepes. One fateful night on New Years Eve, the world will be changed forever…
share_text: Sometimes, the world no longer needs heroes. What it needs is a monster.

special_desc: When a disciplined former Secret Service agent is forced to partner with a reckless global pop star after his daughter is kidnapped by her obsessive ex, their race across the Philippines ignites a volatile romance- one that forces them to choose between control, trust, and the people they love most.
share_text: A disciplined agent and a reckless pop star must learn to trust each other—or lose everything. But the greatest risk? Falling in love.

special_desc: After her father’s business goes bankrupt, Skylar Stone is forced to work as Lucas Ford’s maid as collateral. But just when she thinks things can’t get worse, an unexpected pregnancy shatters her world. Lucas, convinced of her betrayal, demands she get an abortion, leaving her devastated. Heartbreak forces her to leave her homeland, but six years later, she returns—with her child and a story far from over.
share_text: She scrubbed his floors to pay off a debt, but her biggest secret? The son he never knew!

special_desc: Marina Sinclair is unloved by her family. Framed by her sister and thrown into jail, she's shamed by her father, cursed by her mother, and blamed by her brother. After cutting ties for good, she unexpectedly becomes the cherished obsession of Damien Yates, the untouchable "Golden Scion" of the city. Only then does she realize: Damien has always been the light in her darkest days — silently guarding, healing, and loving her. To him, she's always been exclusive.
share_text: Betrayed by her family but cherished by the most powerful man. Her real story begins when she walks away.

special_desc: Best friends Summer and Faye are unexpectedly thrust into the world of a novel, assuming the roles of the devoted wife to the shrewd Adrian Watson and the stand-in lover for the possessive Julian Watson. While they seem ensnared in unrequited love, they secretly revel in the opulent lifestyle of the elite. But, the return of Mia Piper, another key heroine, shatters their tranquil existence. To escape the looming tragic fate, they devise a daring plan to fake their own deaths. Unbeknownst to them, their "deaths" push Adrian and Julian to the brink of despair. Then, a chance encounter brings the four back together again...
share_text: Now, can they outsmart the story itself?

special_desc: For seven years, Summer and her childhood friend Shawn shared a bond brimming with unspoken affection. After a spontaneous, drunken kiss, Shawn, wary of intimacy, pushed Summer away with his erratic behavior. Disheartened, Summer becomes the object of affection for another childhood friend, Julian, despite Shawn's persistent interference. Just as her relationship with Julian deepens, he mysteriously disappears...
share_text: Amid unexpected twists, will Summer find her path to a happy ending?

special_desc: Caroline Winsor, once a pawn in her mother's quest for luxury, is betrothed to the controlling tycoon Dominic. On the day of their grand wedding, she decides to escape, only to find herself in the thrilling world of underground racing, ruled by the enigmatic Wyatt. Unbeknownst to all, this icy racer harbors a secret identity. What could happen between a fallen heiress and a street racer?
share_text: Runaway bride meets dangerous street racer!

special_desc:
Hockey star Kaelen proposes on ice. Jealous Isolde drives into Lia—Kaelen is gravely injured saving her. Lia donates a kidney to save him, but Isolde fakes a cruel farewell letter and forces her away.

Awakened, Kaelen believes Lia abandoned him. Heartbroken, Lia is diagnosed with leukemia and leaves for Switzerland.

Five years later, Lia returns as a chauffeur, drowning in debt. Kaelen, now a superstar, mistakes her for a gold-digger and hires her as his humiliated personal assistant. She silently endures his hatred and Isolde's abuse—until she throws herself in front of a car to protect him. The doctor reveals the truth: Lia was his kidney donor all along.

Isolde is arrested. Kaelen declares Lia his fiancée. A year later, she escapes from the Swiss hospital to his rink—and they kiss on the ice, vowing to spend every remaining moment together.
share_text: he saved his life. He punished her for it.

special_desc: Stella Langford's college shuts down. She has to transfer to another college, but ends up living with Nathaniel Hawthorne, CEO of Hawthorne Group. They are forced into a contract marriage. Bullied by socialite Vicky Swing, Stella fights back with her sharp wits and shooting skills. But when her true identity and a buried past begin to surface, Nathaniel realizes the girl he married on paper is the one he's been destined to protect all along.
share_text: She is his contract wife. He never expected she’d be his destiny.

special_desc: After June and her parents die in a freak accident, she finally sees her family's true colors. Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.
share_text: She gave up everything, and suddenly, everyone wants her back.

Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.
share_text: She gave up everything, and suddenly, everyone wants her back.

special_desc: Elowen, a "Wolfless" outcast, is betrayed and sent to the palace as a breeding candidate for four fierce princes. In a desperate fight for survival, she awakens the legendary "Silver Wolf" bloodline. Her power not only tames the princes' madness but also allows her to expose conspiracies and overthrow a tyrannical king. Ultimately, she is crowned the Alpha Queen by all four princes, rising from nothing to hold supreme power.
share_text: She was their breeding candidate. She became their queen.

book_title: My Brothers Begged, But I'm the Dragon's Queen
special_desc: In the Solis Empire, locked in eternal winter, only a marriage between a princess of pure royal blood and the Abyss Dragon can bring back the warmth of the sun. Princess Diana grew up happy alongside her three brothers — until Lorelei arrived. Using a stolen Dragon's scale, Lorelei seized all of Diana's love and standing. Deceived, the three brothers cast Diana aside — even offering her as a sacrifice to slay the dragon. Only after the dragon took Diana away did the truth emerge. By then, it was too late.
share_text: My brothers gave me to a dragon. Now he obeys me, and they'll pay for their betrayal.

special_desc: She stepped back to support her husband's rise, then he cheated, his mistress attacked, and her daughter nearly died. Now this queen is done playing nice. She's freezing his power, exposing their crimes, and taking back everything—one ruthless move at a time.
share_text: Betray a queen? She'll bury you in heels.

special_desc: She was injured and blinded in an accident, becoming an orphan. Her uncle, greedy for her parents' inheritance, pretended to adopt her. When they found out she didn't know where the inheritance was, they quickly married her off to a seriously ill tycoon. On their wedding day, she was humiliated and injured by her cousin but unexpectedly regained her sight. Upon seeing her mother-in-law having an affair, she continued to pretend to be blind. While acting pitiful and obedient at home, she was a formidable businesswoman outside, eventually becoming the CEO of a company. A billionaire of the partner company fell in love with her at first sight, , unaware that they were actually married for years but had never met each other...
share_text: No one knows that I, the obedient blind daughter-in-law at home, am actually the CEO of a company...

special_desc:
Born with the mystical Water Pearl, Eileen spent her childhood abused by her own family.
They sacrificed her to the abyss. That was the moment her ultimate ice magic awakened.
Eileen tamed a deadly dragon, returned to save her younger brother, and made everyone who betrayed her pay.
Inside the royal palace, she exposed the queen’s conspiracy. Beneath the sea, she rescued her mother and defeated the monsters threatening the kingdom.
In the end, Eileen rose as the Queen of the Seas.
share_text: Her family sold her. She bought an empire.

special_desc: Selene Ward shattered her wolf soul at ten to save Tristan, Dark Moon's future Alpha. For eight years, she endured being called "wolfless," clinging to his promise that she would be his Luna. At his coronation, he held her down while his new girlfriend cut her hair with silver scissors, then rejected their mate bond before a thousand witnesses. Selene accepted his rejection, severed her pack bond, and walked away—with her father, Dark Moon's head warrior, beside her. No one knew that losing Tristan would awaken her dormant bloodline. At Apex Royal Academy, she meets Ryker Thorne, a "useless playboy" hiding the power of a pureblood Lycan king, and discovers a mate bond ten thousand times stronger than the one she lost. Selene rises from outcast to legendary commander as Dark Moon crumbles without her. The wolfless girl never returns. The White Wolf Queen takes her place.
share_text: I lost my wolf saving him. He repaid me by cutting my hair onstage and rejecting me before the whole pack. He thought my wolf was broken. She was only waiting.

special_desc: Dumped for her poor background, Sabrina Shaw is struck by lightning, awakening x-ray vision via her grandma's bracelet. She dives into the high-stakes jade gambling world, uncovering rare treasures one after another, outwits her enemies, and seizes control of Bennett Jewelry and the Jade Association. Her legendary comeback culminates when she unveils the mythical Imperial Green at the grand Jade Expo.
share_text: Struck by lightning, she becomes Jade Queen!

special_desc: Wesley Creed, the King of War Tech, hides his identity in order to keep his dead squadmates' research alive, only to be treated like dirt. 3 years later, he's ready to reclaim his identity.
share_text: In war? He's the alpha.

special_desc: In 1849, the American West, poor dockworker William is betrayed by his lover and his boss, losing everything and becoming a slave laborer in a gold mine. On the brink of death, he awakens a mysterious "Golden Eye" that allows him to see through anything and uncover hidden treasures. From a powerless nobody to a legendary mining tycoon, William uses his extraordinary vision and intelligence to defeat the elites who once crushed him!
share_text: Betrayed and reduced to a mine slave, William awakens Golden Eye and rises from a powerless worker to a legendary tycoon.

book_title: My Sister Stole My Mate, So I Married a King
special_desc: At my own Mate Claim Ceremony, Cassian rejected me and took my sister Maris’s hand, claiming he only wanted to save her from the Council. Then he tried to rip my dead mother’s moonstone necklace from my neck so Maris could wear it as his chosen Luna. The chain broke. So did the last reason I had to wait for him. In three days, the Council would send me to Rowan Vale, the Lycan king’s dying heir. Everyone pitied me. But Rowan was the first man to ask if I chose him freely.
share_text: My mate rejected me. The dying Lycan heir made me his Luna.

book_title: The Frozen Lycan King Claims His Bride
special_desc: Isabella thought she had found her fated mate, but her beloved bodyguard Holden ruthlessly betrays her for her manipulative stepsister. Brutally abused and abandoned, she is forced by her greedy father to marry Ronan, the Frozen Lycan King—a comatose ruler trapped in an ice coffin. Expecting a life of cold despair, Isabella accepts her dark fate, only to accidentally awaken the fearsome king from his icy slumber. With an ancient contract surfacing and a terrifying new power awakening, how will Isabella survive the deadly conspiracies surrounding her?
share_text: Betrayed and brutally whipped by her fated mate, she is forced to marry a frozen Lycan King. Her kiss shatters his curse! Watch the ultimate Queen's revenge as her ex drops to his knees to beg!

special_desc: After a global flood forces humanity into an ocean survival game, Calvin starts with nothing but a broken raft. He soon unlocks the hidden class of Supreme Machinist, allowing him to upgrade and rebuild almost anything. While others struggle to survive, Calvin turns scrap into powerful equipment and sea monsters into valuable resources. As his raft grows into a mighty warship, he rises from castaway to ruler of the seas, setting his sights on the legendary Ark Continent.
share_text: The bigger the monster, the better the upgrade.

book_title: King Of Mars：From Red Dust He Rises
special_desc:
Max, a Martian prince born with extraordinary powers, witnesses his mother being poisoned and his throne usurped by his uncle Silas. Cast into the wilderness and left to die, Max survives and sets out on a path of vengeance and rescue.
He joins forces with a team of mercenaries and, amid the brutal arenas of Mars, awakens his power of “Reversal.” Step by step, he exposes Silas’s conspiracy and ultimately returns to the palace to reclaim the throne and secure the future of Mars.
share_text: From outcast to king. He reversed it all.

special_desc:
In her past life, Liriel, Princess of the Moon Elves, loved her betrothed, the paladin Kaelen. When the Abyss crisis struck, he abandoned her to save Elara. Liriel was mortally wounded, her golden hair withered. Reborn at the betrothal temple, she watched Elara claim the golden oath meant for Kaelen. Heartbroken, Liriel signed the black oath of Azriel, the cursed Goblin Lord.

Elara burned her relics, framed her, and killed her spirit bird, Snow. Kaelen publicly flogged Liriel, and her father moved to strip her title. Near death, Liriel was saved by Azriel, whose thousand-year curse her moonlight power had long eased. They forged a protection pact. Cold to all, Azriel cherished only her. When the Elf coalition and Elara attacked, he sacrificed his demon core and bound their lives forever. Together they exposed Elara’s plots. Elara was disfigured; Kaelen was doomed to regret. Liriel rose as Queen of the Abyss, loved eternally by Azriel.
share_text: Abandoned by the hero. Crowned by the monster.

special_desc: The story takes place in a bustling American city and tells the angsty yet sweet love story between elite scholar Serena and Leo, the Wolf King of North America. Six years ago, Serena, an Ivy League student, was framed out of jealousy by Vivian. She accidentally saved Leo, who was in heat, in a church and was forced to mate with him. Because she gave birth to a son, Liam, who bore wolf-like traits, she was expelled from school and plunged to the bottom of society. Six years later, in order to raise $150,000 for her son's surgery, Serena applied to become Leo's personal nutritionist. Although Vivian kept interfering and tampered with the paternity test report, the bond of blood compelled Leo to fiercely protect his own without even realizing it. After crushing workplace bullying and threats from old enemies, the truth about the fake report came to light, and the family of three was reunited. Meanwhile, a hidden vampire crisis quietly began to unfold.
share_text: Fake report. True blood. Wolf King's family.

special_desc: Talia Stone comes from a wealthy family. Her dad is a billionaire and her three brothers are bigwigs in the military, showbiz and finance world. She saved her childhood friend Jack Chase in an accident and almost lost her legs. Talia's legs were saved by top doctors in the field, but she remained in a wheelchair at her dad's request, as a test for Jack's feelings. The day before their wedding, Talia found out Jack was cheating with her friend Rachel. Enraged by the pair's brazen denial, Talia pretended to turn the other cheek while setting up a plan to humiliate them at the wedding. She then met Aiden Brooks who got her purse back from a thief and asked him half-jokingly to marry her. To her surprise, Aiden said yes. The next day, Talia's supposed wedding turned into a big stage for drama.
share_text: Watch a woman serve revenge at her wedding.
