book_title: Bride Swaps Groom on the Spot
special_desc:
She spent seven years with the wrong man. On her wedding day, at 8:58, she texted the one who'd been waiting: "Come get me."
He showed up — with cars, timing, and seven years of patience.
She chose wrong at first.
share_text: Missed the perfect time? True love wins!

special_desc:
After the sudden death of her father, Charlotte is cruelly abused by her succubus stepmother and two stepsisters. At an elven banquet, the Orc Queen arrives to choose a new bride with a magical goblin. After being secretly framed by her stepsister, Charlotte is chosen by the goblin and taken back to the orc castle as a “bargaining chip.” She is ordered to choose between two orc princes and marry one of them at her 18th birthday ceremony.
At Saint Elaine’s Supernatural Academy, Charlotte meets two orc princes with completely opposite personalities: Vesper, an aloof, restrained snake prince with dark hair, and Claude, a charismatic, sunshine-bright lion prince with golden hair. As her stepsisters Skyler and Blair relentlessly torment her at school and the lecherous hyena Logan repeatedly schemes against her, the two princes transform into fiercely protective mates. They publicly declare Charlotte as theirs in front of the entire school, and time and again, they unleash their full beast forms—the Golden Berserker Lion and the Black-Armored Giant Serpent—to rescue her from danger.
As they spend more time together and their intertwined fates pull them deeper into one another’s lives, Charlotte finds herself torn between the possessive, jealous Vesper and the gentle, devoted Claude. Caught between their overwhelming affection, she gradually falls hopelessly in love with both. On the eve of her coming-of-age ceremony, she even takes the final step with Vesper inadvertently awakening the rare and supreme bloodline of the “Holy Elf,” an ancient elven lineage of unparalleled power.
share_text: An elven girl is caught between a lion prince and a snake prince. Which one will she choose?

special_desc: Ava discovers her boyfriend wagered her away in a bet, but the man who spent the night with her was never him. It was his powerful twin brother, Killian. What neither brother knows is that Ava recognized the truth from the very beginning. While they fight to control her, she quietly turns their game into their downfall.
share_text: Her boyfriend bet her away. She spent the night with his twin instead.

special_desc: The Bride's mate betrays her by eloping with her sister, who was originally meant to marry the most feared Alpha King in history. To protect her pack, the Bride agrees to marry the Alpha King in her sister's place. Her former mate remains unaware of the switch, still believing she is his bride. The two wedding ceremonies are held simultaneously. Just as the Bride is about to leave forever, her former mate realizes the truth and, consumed by regret, seizes her from the Alpha King in a desperate bid to win her back. But the Bride's heart already belongs to the Alpha King—and the two have become true mates. Can her former mate still reclaim what he lost?
share_text: Her mate elopes with her sister, so she marries the feared Alpha King instead. When her ex discovers the switch, he comes to steal her back—but her heart already belongs to her true mate.

special_desc:
The small town of Moonridge in the Pacific Northwest is secretly ruled by a werewolf clan. Ava, the eldest daughter of the declining Reed werewolf family, is branded a “useless outcast” for her inability to shift into a wolf. She is forced to toil endlessly for her kin.
Desperate to secure alliance gold to pay off family debts, her mother compels her to take her younger sister’s place — the sister refuses the match — and marry Damon, the ruthless new Alpha of the Blackwood Pack. Ava steps into Blackwood Lodge in despair, yet unexpectedly wins the affection of Damon’s mother, Martha. The cold‑hearted Damon is also gradually moved by her resilience as they spend time together.
Hidden deep within Ava flows the Moon‑Blessed Luna Blood, a power that begins to revive the fading wolf pack. Her parasitic birth family comes crawling back once more, and her jealous younger sister attempts to seduce Damon. This time, Ava refuses to back down. With the support of Martha and Damon, she severs all ties with the Reed family. What was once feared as a den of wolves ultimately becomes her true home.
share_text: Outcast bride. Pack savior. True home.

special_desc: After Dante Conti let his mistress Selena Russo torment their six-year-old daughter Sofia, Isabella Moretti fought back and was locked inside Ashford Sanitarium. Years later, Dante forced her to sign away her rights with Sofia’s urn as a threat, believing he had broken her forever. But Sicily turned the abandoned wife into Don Moretti. Backed by Luca Ricci, the Don of Palermo, and the hidden power of her father Vittorio, Isabella returns to New York’s Five Families banquet to expose Selena’s lies, reclaim her empire, and make Dante watch the Conti throne collapse for every drop of blood he spilled.
share_text: He used my daughter's ashes to break me, so I returned to bury his throne.

special_desc: On the night of her dream wedding, Silicon Valley heiress Avery Stone learns her new husband, Ethan Vale, slept with another woman “to practice” and is leaving their bridal suite to legally marry her. When Ethan uses a secret intimate video to trap Avery in their billion-dollar merger marriage, she stops crying and starts planning. His mistress tries to expose Avery online, but Avery flips the trap, turning Ethan’s own verified account into a global scandal. As his empire collapses, obsession, pregnancy, blackmail, and revenge spiral into a deadly final confrontation, while Avery fights to reclaim her name, power, and heart.
share_text: A betrayed billionaire bride turns her husband’s secret video threat into a viral revenge scandal that destroys his empire.

book_title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband
special_desc: Sebastian Klein is a loser and an ex-con. No girl in her right mind would marry him... until you!
share_text: Sebastian Klein is a loser and an ex-con. No girl in her right mind would marry him... until you!

book_title: The Return of My Mafia Husband
special_desc: Leo has been concealed his identity as the Mafia King while dating an ordinary girl Olivia. Just as he prepares to reveal his identity to her, a car accident leaves him in a vegetative state. Olivia remains faithfully by his side. Eight years later, Leo awakens and his first action is to propose to Olivia. Olivia's relatives and friends think Leo is just a poor guy in a wheelchair, unaware that he is actually Don Gambino, the heir to the most powerful Mafia family in the world.
share_text: What? That poor son-in-law in the wheelchair is the Mafia king?!

special_desc: Cora’s husband helps his dead best friend’s widow get pregnant, then defends her at every turn, calling it kindness while his own marriage collapses. When his loyalty turns violent and costs Cora her unborn child, she stops begging and starts collecting proof. Armed with Sienna’s recorded confession, Cora forces a brutal divorce, walks away with what she is owed, and watches the woman who stole her husband trap the Vance family in the scandal they created.
share_text: He gave a widow his sperm. His wife recorded the affair and took everything.

special_desc: Driven to despair after losing both her husband and baby, Vivienne only lives for one thing - REVENGE! But simple murder doesn't torture enough. Why not steal her husband and make her watch!
share_text: A husband for a husband! This is V for Vendetta!

book_title: Husband and Kids Chose Her Over Me
special_desc: Housewife Sarah knew her husband Lucas was arrested for participating in prostitution. She hurriedly went there, but her husband even blamed her for being too slow. Because he didn't want his first love to get sunburnt. Sarah decided to divorce Lucas. But her two children, whom she had raised with deep love, sided with the mistress Grace. Sarah decided to go abroad and leave this family. After Sarah left, Grace revealed her true colors. The children began to miss their mom, but Sarah would never turn back.
share_text: My husband and children chose a homewrecker over me.

book_title: Love Found Her After the Divorce
special_desc: After a chance encounter reveals her "struggling" husband, Paxon, is actually a billionaire, Sienna's world shatters. When a casual apology is his only offer for gifting jewels to another, she walks away. Now divorced, Paxon expects her to return. But Sienna stuns everyone by entering a marriage contract with a mysterious tycoon.
share_text: True love precedes a remarriage.

special_desc: For five years, Esther has been trapped in an abusive marriage. Her husband, Carl, cheated on her, was physically violent, and indirectly caused the death of their daughter. On their fifth wedding anniversary, during another violent confrontation, Carl dies accidentally. In shock, Esther buries his body in the backyard and goes to sleep. The next morning, Carl appears in front of her again — alive and behaving like the caring, gentle man he once was when they first fell in love. His personality no longer matches the abusive husband she buried. Esther begins to question what is happening. Did Carl somehow return from the dead, or has someone replaced him?
share_text: If he’s alive…who did she bury?

book_title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up!
special_desc: You're the replacement bride to a billionaire in a coma, but what happens when he wakes up?
share_text: You're the replacement bride to a billionaire in a coma, but what happens when he wakes up?

special_desc: Rejected by her whole family, Rebecca uses a system to be reborn. Then she gets a bold proposal from her ex's rival, Xavier Kingsley. Strangely, Xavier knows all her habits and always defends her against her toxic past. She assumes she is just a substitute for him, but turns out, she is his true love!
share_text: She thought she was just a substitute, until he confessed!

book_title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up! 2
special_desc: Ellie Holland is forced to marry bigshot billionaire Wayne Lyons in order to save her father's life. For the hefty price of five million dollars, Ellie sold herself into the Lyons family with the promise of delivering an heir. There's just one catch… Wayne Lyons is in a coma!
share_text: You have to marry Wayne Lyons to save your father's life, there's just one catch... he's in a coma!

book_title: Spoiled By The CEO After Rebirth
special_desc: In her past life, she was framed and lost everything by her husband and cousin. It's only on her deathbed that she realizes the billionaire she was once engaged to truly loves her. Reborn two years earlier, she wakes up and sets her sights on marrying the billionaire. This time, she won't allow tragedy to strike again. And this billionaire? He's not a playboy at all. His heart belongs only to her.
share_text: The playboy billionaire has loved me for two lifetimes!
book_sub_title: Spoiled by a Playful Husband After Rebirth

special_desc: Synopsis:Fresh off her divorce, Ava travels to Hawaii for a getaway with her brother-in-law Jack, and the pair cross moral boundaries through a series of lingering temptations. When their secret comes to light, a marriage crumbles and the two sisters suffer a bitter falling-out. Burdened by guilt, both women grow and heal separately over their long estrangement. Ultimately, they bridge the rift between them, rebuild their sisterly bond despite the scars, and find true redemption.
share_text: Betrayal, guilt, estrangement—then redemption.

book_title: Sleeping with My Ex Husband's Son
special_desc: Natalie built a thriving company but endured a disastrous marriage. Her ex-husband, Harrison, was caught having an affair with her female intern in the office — then had the gall to mock her as “a dead fish in bed.” Enraged, Natalie slapped him and walked out without looking back. After the divorce, Natalie unexpectedly crosses paths with Harrison’s son, Sebastian. But this meeting is no accident — eight years earlier, when he was still underage, Sebastian had already developed a secret infatuation with her. Now, driven by a need for revenge against his father, he hides his true identity as a powerful heir and joins Natalie’s company as her new intern. By day, Natalie is Sebastian’s boss. By night, Sebastian controls her deepest desires. Bound by a sexual pact, they become entangled in a web of lust and deception, navigating corporate battles, family vendettas, and the messy entanglements of the heart.
share_text: By day her intern. By night her sin. By blood, her ex's son.

book_title: When My Husband Became My Father-in-Law
special_desc:
Prince Jacob of the werewolf clan and his father King Edward are cursed in the aftermath of a war, swapping their bodies. They are also stricken with an aphrodisiac poison that can only be cured by intimate union with Princess Evelyn.
The witch delivers the remedy: Evelyn must choose one of them within seven days and attain genuine emotional fulfilment with her pick; otherwise, both men will perish, and the entire tribe will be destroyed. Trapped between her husband’s soul inhabiting the king’s body and her father-in-law’s soul trapped inside her husband’s form, Evelyn is plunged into an agonising dilemma.
Further investigation reveals that Jacob orchestrated the curse from the very start in a bid to seize the throne. Crushed by this betrayal, Evelyn resolves to fight back. She allies with Edward to devise a counterplot, paying Jacob back in his own coin. Thus unfolds a werewolf conflict woven around power, betrayal and redemption.
share_text: Two souls swapped. Seven days to choose.

book_title: My Husband Gifted Me His Rival
special_desc: For three years, Elena endured a marriage where every affair ended the same way—her husband handed her another man as compensation. When his pregnant mistress demanded a wedding, he expected another fake divorce and another obedient return. Instead, Elena accepted the young man he chose, signed the papers, and walked away for good. By the time Damian uncovered the truth behind the betrayal that destroyed their marriage, she was already standing at another altar. This time, the bride never looked back.
share_text: Her husband bought her another man. She married him instead.

book_title: The Don's Abandoned Ex-Wife Strikes Back
special_desc: For five years, Serena built Adrian's empire, only to be branded a traitor when he protected his childhood sweetheart. Exiled, hunted, and presumed powerless, she vanishes for three years. Then she appears at a Blackwood underground auction, puts a gun to her rival's head, and claims the castle as her territory. Everyone expects her execution. Instead, the feared Vincent Blackwood steps forward and names Serena as his wife. She did not return for Adrian. She returned with evidence, an army, and a trap for everyone who destroyed her.
share_text: They exiled her as a traitor. She returned as the Blackwood queen they all feared.

special_desc: Evelyn is a Harvard-trained surgeon quietly married to Boston's most private billionaire, and one wrong Slack message turns her whole department against her. Vanessa, a new intern, posts selfies from the driver's seat of Evelyn's custom G-Wagon, correctly names the interior color, and calls her attending a broke liar desperate for attention. When a florist arrives with roses for Mrs. Sinclair, Vanessa shoves her aside, takes them, and puts her fiancé on speaker to come defend her honor — announcing his name is Nathaniel Sinclair. Genuinely curious who her husband has been all this time, Evelyn simply texts him to pick her up after work. What walks into that lobby is the real CEO, an administration lined up to congratulate the wrong woman, and a man Nathaniel recognizes instantly: his own driver, who's been borrowing his cars, watch, estate and name to pull women in bars. But the unmasking isn't the end. Vanessa has a livestream, a pregnancy, a sob story and millions of viewers ready to believe the rich stole everything from her — and Evelyn has every hour of footage that proves otherwise.
share_text: I misfired a photo of my new G-Wagon into the hospital group chat. An intern accused me of stealing pictures of her car — then told everyone she was Mrs. Sinclair.

special_desc: Elena Miller spent three years in a coma — a coma she earned saving her fiancé Liam's life. She woke up to find a woman named Vanessa wearing her clothes, raising children everyone called hers, and living in every space she'd left behind. Worse, Liam and her brother James were secretly keeping her legs paralyzed to make sure she could never leave. When Elena discovered the truth and tried to fight back, her own brother whipped her ninety-nine times in a locked cellar — then walked away without looking back. So Elena stopped fighting them. She started planning. With the help of a long-estranged aunt, she rehabilitated her legs in secret, faked her own death, and vanished. In a quiet mountain town, she found a life that was finally hers — and a man who never once asked her to be grateful for being loved.
share_text: I was in a coma for three years. When I woke up, my fiancé, my brother, and my parents had already replaced me.

book_title: Ex-Convict Nanny and Billionaire Single Dad
special_desc: Fresh out of prison, Grace landed a job as a nanny. Her boss, the ruthless billionaire Alex Hill, cares only about his precious daughter. Grace passed Alex's rigorous test and gradually won over his cold heart, but Grace holds a dark secret, one that could destroy everything good.
share_text: Billionaire falls for me—his ex-convict nanny.

book_title: The CEO's Wife is A Badass
special_desc: Cora, a modest artist and the wife of billionaire Brandon Pearson, finds herself managing his gallery while he's away on business. However, her role as the CEO's wife is unexpectedly eclipsed by her college classmate Ashley, leaving Cora scorned by her colleagues. Can Cora reclaim her place and prove her worth?
share_text: A billionaire CEO's wife battles to expose deceit and reclaim her stolen identity and status as an heiress.

special_desc: Evelyn Shaw believed Adrian Grant loved her. To the world, he was the devoted husband who kissed her at galas and called her his only weakness. But after years of kidnappings, scars, and a lost child, Evelyn discovers the truth: Adrian built their marriage to make her a decoy wife, a public target meant to keep his real love, Maya Cole, safe. When she uncovers his diary, hidden money transfers, and the lies behind every “rescue,” Evelyn uses Maya’s arrogance to secure Adrian’s signature, files for divorce, erases her trail, and disappears. By the time Adrian realizes what he destroyed, Evelyn has already chosen herself.
share_text: He made me the target for his true love, so I disappeared and chose myself.

special_desc:
Mia’s life is picture-perfect on the outside: a cooking-and-cleaning housewife. On the inside, she’s a surgeon with extreme OCD. Two years of marriage to Jimmy, and she’s still untouched—he finds her boring, stiff, and way too “proper.” Threatened with divorce to learn “bedroom skills,” Mia grabs a check and heads to a secret club, desperate for a teacher to save her marriage. She’s forced into a sexy outfit, blindfolded, and challenged to paint on her own body—a test in breaking free from her OCD shell.
Upstairs, Mafia don Nick finishes handling a traitor. In the glass elevator, he spots blindfolded Mia on stage and can’t look away. As the doors close, a spotlight drops toward her. Nick reacts instinctively, smashing through the doors, saving her, and whisking her away. And so begins a twisted, passionate game of training, desire, and forbidden romance.
share_text: She wanted a teacher. She found a captor.

special_desc: The Young Marshal claims, 'My wife is a naive country girl, do not bully her!' The socialites she upstaged cry, 'Who is bullying who?' He adds, 'My wife is gentle and knows nothing about medicine or guns!' Her cured patients and dead enemies scream, 'Are you blind, Young Marshal?' 'My wife is perfectly obedient, my word is law!' he boasts heroically—while kneeling on a washboard. The adjutants of the Warlord mansion sigh, 'Please keep some dignity, Young Marshal!'
share_text: Pretends soft lady, turns out tough soul!

special_desc: Five years married, and he kicked me out for his "amnesiac" sister. After I miscarried, he said, "Let's get divorced, just pretend, to keep her calm." So I signed the real papers, blocked him. Her fake amnesia got exposed, she ended up in a psych ward. He faked cancer, then a car crash. Years later, I'm on Forbes, my sister's insane, my mother lives on the $200 a month I give her, and the man who threw me away is just someone I don't even bother to name anymore. They tried to destroy me, now I'm out of their reach.
share_text: My sister pretended to lose her memory and took my man. Now she's in a mental hospital and I'm rich.

book_title: Mr. Walker, Your Ex-Wife is Your Boss
special_desc: Emily marries Ronan Walker, but divorces him after discovering his affair with Vivian Hart. She returns to acting to regain independence and meets Ronan's friend William. Amid conflicts, the truth emerges. When Ronan is injured saving Emily, they reconcile and rekindle their love, starting anew.
share_text: Old love, second chance, new beginning.

special_desc: Isabella believed Salvatore was the man who saved her. He killed her abusive father, built a mafia empire for her, and swore there would be no divorce, only death. Then she uncovered 1,800 photos of another woman. When the mistress stole everything she had bled to protect, Isabella fought back with blood instead. But exposing his betrayal uncovers an even crueler truth. The child she lost, the family they dreamed of, and the marriage she died to protect were all destroyed by the man she loved most.
share_text: He killed her abuser to save her. Years later, he became the monster she feared most.

special_desc: New York's two deadliest queenpins, Vera Marchetti and Bianca Conti, have been rivals for twenty years and lovers in secret. When Bianca is exposed as a fake heiress, stripped of her name, and thrown to the enemies she made for her family, Vera flies home to claim the only person allowed to kill her. Together they turn a blood debt into a power play, crush the Contis, and make the underworld watch its most dangerous enemies become wives.
share_text: They wanted my enemy dead. I came back to make her my wife.

book_title: Rock On! Band Beauty in Disguise
special_desc: This story follows Astra, a determined girl gifted with extraordinary strength. When her twin brother loses his voice before a crucial band rehearsal, he’s threatened by a lawsuit. Astra steps in for him. Disguised as a boy, she resides in the boys’ dorm to uphold the ruse despite lacking musical talent and being unmistakably female. Amidst comedic mishaps and tense moments, Astra discovers unexpected love and genuine companionship.
share_text: To avoid a massive debt, a girl with remarkable strength takes on her younger brother's identity to front the campus band, leading to an unexpected love story.

book_title: The Luna Who Broke the Bond
special_desc: On Evelyn’s wedding night, she finds her Alpha husband Lucian in bed with Celeste, her best friend. While he calls her a gold-digger, her phone lights up: her mother is dead. Minutes later, Evelyn miscarries his child, and Lucian walks away to a party. Branded a liar and trapped by the Moon Bond, she is forced to serve the woman who stole her life. But a Luna mark never bleeds without reason. At the elders’ banquet, Evelyn’s silver wound reveals the truth: Lucian abandoned his pregnant Luna. Now she will break the bond, bury his lies, and take the pack he thought owned her.
share_text: On her wedding night, Evelyn catches her Alpha with her best friend, but only her bleeding Luna mark can prove the baby he denied was real.

special_desc: Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.
share_text: He called me a useless disgrace and rejected me, but I'm the fated mate of the Lycan King.

special_desc:
On her eighteenth birthday, the Beta’s daughter loses everything. First, her childhood sweetheart, the Alpha heir, and her best friend are revealed to be fated mates. Then, a brutal attack leaves her pack in ruins and both her parents dead.
Determined to leave it all behind, she goes to say goodbye to the Alpha heir, only to catch him in bed with her traitorous best friend. That is the final blow. Turning her back on the pack, she becomes a rogue.
But exile changes everything. On the road, an extraordinary power awakens within her, revealing a shocking royal heritage. No longer a helpless wolf, she must now destroy a ruthless human trafficking ring and save the entire werewolf race. And along the dangerous path to reclaiming her throne, she will finally find her fated mate.
share_text: My boyfriend became my best friend's mate, so I walked away from the pack. But I never thought I was the last heir to the royal bloodline... and my true mate is waiting.

special_desc: Ten years ago, Elara was adopted by the Alpha of the Stormfang Pack and was destined to choose one of his five sons as her mate. However, the five brothers fall for a manipulative omega maid named Jenny, who schemes to humiliate and torment Elara. Heartbroken and exhausted, Elara publicly rejects her mate bond with the five brothers on her eighteenth birthday and announces her engagement to the mysterious and powerful Lycan Prince, Xavier Lockhart. As the brothers finally uncover Jenny's deception and desperately try to win Elara back, they realize it is too late. Elara finds her true mate in Xavier, breaking his deadly curse, and moves on to a new life, leaving her painful past behind.
share_text: Hurt. Betrayed. She rejectes all five alpha mates!

book_title: The Luna He Lost on His Wedding Day
special_desc: Celine loves Crown Prince Adrian, only to discover that he married her to protect her stepsister, Vanessa. After enduring his repeated betrayal and cruelty, Celine exchanges their engagement on the wedding day and marries Rowan, the disabled former heir. With Rowan's respect and protection, their marriage of convenience gradually becomes real love. Meanwhile, Adrian finally discovers that Celine—not Vanessa—was the woman who saved his life, and desperately tries to win her back. As the truth about the Moonheart Stone, Vanessa's lies, and the Ashford family's betrayal is exposed, Celine refuses to return to her old life and chooses Rowan once and for all.
share_text: He chose the wrong sister. She chose the right man.

special_desc: When Emma Parker turns 18, she discovers her fated mate is Logan Carter, the alpha of her pack. But that happiness is short-lived when Logan rejects her for another she-wolf. Soon after, Emma learns that she is no ordinary wolf, and that many dangerous people are after her. Alpha Logan rejected Emma, so why is he willing to risk it all to keep Emma safe?
share_text: You were rejected by your mate, your pack's alpha! But he doesn't know your goddess-given secret.

special_desc: He killed his vicious father to save her.  Now the new Alpha King must hide his fated mate and use a decoy fake Luna to keep her alive. But while he’s away battling, she’s discovered by the Fake Luna and brutally tortured.  Can she survive long enough for the Alpha King’s return and vengeance?
share_text: Two Lunas. One will burn.

special_desc: Her whole life, Heather has slaved for a vampire family, until she forms an unimaginable bond with Theo, a vampire king. Now she must find answers to all the mysteries -- what happened to her lost childhood memories? How did the bond happen? Is Theo the death of her, or the love of her life?
share_text: You formed a bond with a vampire king. Will you break it, or risk your life to protect it?

special_desc: Introverted Cameron, is desperately in love with his high school crush Diane. But his romantic pursuit is halted when Victoria, a female vampire moves in next door. Cameron soon discovers he's in the middle of a life-and-death adventure.
share_text: Victoria, a female vampire, moves in next door. Cameron is in a life-and-death adventure.

book_title: Blood and Roses: Tears of a Vampire
special_desc: Aria has served vampire lord Alexander as his thrall for three years. He forgets their blood oath renewal night for his new lover Carmilla, leaving Aria to a lethal curse. Aria turns to Prince Cassius, who saves her from drowning with a bonding kiss. Alexander, regretful, abducts her and forces a wedding. Imprisoned by his father, Cassius breaks free, objects at the altar, and defeats Alexander. Alexander gets 800 years in prison, Carmilla is banished, and Cassius reveals Aria was his mate long before their bond began.
share_text: Aria gave a vampire lord three years of loyalty. He forgot her for another woman and left her for dead. A prince's kiss saves her, but her old master wants her back. Can love survive betrayal?

book_title: My Vampire First Love Regretted Losing Me
special_desc: Lilith, born with rare sacred blood, was raised from childhood by Adrian and Louis, the young masters of the Mar vampire clan. The three shared twenty years of deep affection and companionship. Yet when the scheming human Charlotte appeared, she sowed discord relentlessly. The two brothers believed her lies, imprisoned Lilith, and tormented her without mercy, crushing every trace of their former tenderness. Heartbroken and utterly disillusioned, Lilith agreed to marry the vampire prince, Dracula. Dracula had long cherished Lilith, who had once saved his life; he devoted everything to keeping her safe and protected. When Adrian and Louis finally awoke to the truth, they were consumed with frantic regret and went so far as to disrupt the wedding in a desperate attempt to win her back. In the end, the conspiracy was exposed, and all the villains were brought to justice. The two brothers exiled themselves far away, while Lilith and Dracula were crowned side by side, becoming the sovereigns — the Vampire King and Queen.
share_text: Broken by lies. Crowned by true love.

book_title: Divorce Denied Caged by My Vampire Ex
special_desc:
Human girl Aliyah takes a food delivery job to support her family farm, only to stumble into the ancient castle of Lucius, a two-hundred-year-old pureblood vampire. Mistaken by a witch as his perfect soulmate capable of bearing pureblood heirs, she is forced into a marriage contract with the vampire clan’s lord. On their wedding night, Aliyah receives a message from the witch revealing the horrifying truth—the compatibility reading was wrong, and she can never give Lucius pureblood offspring. If the secret comes out, she will be killed instantly. Desperate to escape, Aliyah is repeatedly confined by the possessive, obsessive Lucius. His half-blood younger brother Alan soon appears, claiming to be her true soulmate and offering her freedom, though he initially plans revenge against pureblood vampires. After fleeing to her grandparents’ quiet countryside farm, Aliyah briefly finds peace, yet she faces constant threats from Serena, a pureblood vampire infatuated with Lucius, and her cruel, money-obsessed birth father.
Through countless life-or-death ordeals, Lucius lets go of his obsession with bloodline reproduction and realizes his genuine love for Aliyah. Alan abandons his vengeance and leaves to travel the world. Free from the false bond of blood compatibility, the two resolve all misunderstandings, stay together out of true affection, and eventually welcome their own pureblood child.
share_text: He chose her for blood. He keeps her for love.

special_desc: Lady Eileen is ninety-nine, richer than kingdoms, and tired of being treated like a dried-up old woman. She spends eighty million gold coins on a beautiful pureblood vampire, Adrian, hoping he'll drink her aged blood and restore her youth. Instead, Adrian rejects her and kneels for her scheming cousin Vera. So Eileen buys Victor, a wounded, lowborn vampire from the blood market. One bite turns her back into an eighteen-year-old beauty, and one act of loyalty turns Victor into the only pet she wants to keep. Now Adrian is begging to return, Vera is trying to steal everything, and Eileen is ready to show them what happens when an old queen gets young again.
share_text: The vampire I bought doesn't want me? Fine, I'll get a more obedient one to make you jealous.

book_title: After Divorce, Four Vampire Kings Chasing Me
special_desc: In order to marry her beloved partner, the female protagonist was willing to seal the power of the ancestral vampire to marry the male protagonist. Eventually, with the help of her family and the female protagonist's support, the male protagonist became the leader of the vampires.However, behind a secret door in her bedroom, she discovered the chamber where her husband have an affair with others.
share_text: She helped him rule the vampires—and found him ruling a secret affair.

special_desc:
What is the end of darkness?
Many say it’s light.
For Clara, it was him — the Vampire King.
Once an ordinary student, Clara’s quiet life shatters when she meets her new chemistry teacher, the enigmatic and commanding Edison. His presence is magnetic, his eyes ancient — and his secret deadly. Edison is not human. He is the King of Vampires… and he came for her.
Bound by fate and blood, Clara becomes entangled in a world she never knew existed — one of royal vampire clans, ancient rivalries, and dangerous magic. She learns a truth buried within her own veins: she carries the bloodline of the Arné, a lineage tied to the origins of vampire power itself.
As enemies rise — including the ruthless vampire Fred, who seeks to claim Clara’s blood — she and Edison must fight side by side. What begins as fear turns into passion; what starts as defiance transforms into destiny.
In the end, under the crimson moon, Clara realizes that love isn’t the end of darkness — it’s the reason to walk through it.
MY VAMPIRE KING — a saga of forbidden love, blood, and fate.
Because even monsters can love… and sometimes, love makes monsters of us all.
share_text: She was his student. He was her doom. Together, they rewrote the rules of darkness.

special_desc:
"Five years ago, on a blood moon night, Ruth, a hotel maid, stumbled into the room of Arthur, the Vampire King. Bound by the pull of soulmates, they shared one night, and Ruth fled the next morning.
Now, Ruth is a desperate single mother whose half-vampire son, Leo, suffers from a rare ""photophobia"" illness that requires a fortune to treat. When a chance encounter brings her to Arthur's castle for a high-paying job, he instantly recognizes his mate. Furious at her disappearance, he coldly torments her, but she endures it all for her son's life.
When Ruth's greedy aunt sells Leo to the extreme ""Exorcism Courtyard,"" Arthur, sensing his bloodline in danger, arrives just in time to witness Ruth shielding their son with her own body. He shatters their defenses with a roar: ""Who dares touch my son!"" The family is united. From protecting his wife and child from a jealous noblewoman to showering them with absolute devotion, Arthur proves that for the ones he loves, he will destroy anyone who stands in their way. Their story ends in a grand wedding and a long-awaited happily ever after."
share_text: Soulmates, secrets, and a half-vampire son. Now the King is coming for them.

book_title: Desired by Two: the Vampire and the Hunter
special_desc: I'm a disaster. One minute I'm spilling coffee on my ridiculously hot boss, Simon, the next I'm discovering I have a secret power I can't control. My world is a mess of spilled coffee and tangled feelings, and I'm caught between two unbelievably hot guys. Simon, my mysterious boss, is as alluring as he is dangerous - a vampire who promises to teach me to harness my magic. Then there's Michael, my kind and loyal best friend. But he's hiding a deadly secret: he's a hunter sworn to destroy everything Simon stands for. They both want me. And as my magic gets more powerful, so does the fire burning between us. How can I choose when they both know my darkest secrets?
share_text: They both want me. And as my magic gets more powerful, so does the fire burning between us. How can I choose when they both know my darkest secrets?

special_desc:
What is betrayal?
Paisley learned it the moment her best friend stabbed her — literally.
What is a vampire?
She learned that too… when one saved her life.
Once a normal high school girl, Paisley’s world shattered when Charlotte — the person she trusted most — betrayed and killed her. But death wasn’t the end. In her final breath, she made a pact with Lucifer himself, rising again with the power of darkness burning in her veins.
Now reborn between life and death, Paisley hunts those who wronged her, guided by demons and protected by supernatural allies—vampires, werewolves, and creatures of the night. But vengeance isn’t the only thing awakening in her heart. The connection between her and Lucifer grows deeper, entangling passion, power, and damnation.
When the “Sin Eaters” threaten to destroy everything she’s become, Paisley must choose between revenge and her new destiny—as the Bride of Hell.
 BETRAYAL AND VAMPIRE — an Anime dark romance of revenge, desire, and rebirth.
Love can kill. Or resurrect.
share_text: Blood for blood. Soul for soul. The devil's bride doesn't negotiate.

special_desc: A banished goddess crash-lands into the life of a bullied heiress. Forced to fix her new family's drama and foil a deadly plot, she discovers that even in poverty, her luck—and love life—is just getting started.
share_text: The family wanted her dead. Too bad a goddess just moved in.

special_desc: After a decade in prison taking his father’s fall, Desmond Kensington comes home to save his mother—only to be tormented relentlessly by his cruel stepmother Veronica and her illegitimate son Roland. Biding his time in silence, he leverages sharp wit and bold resolve to seize the security division, Metropolis Club and Pinnacle Capital, tightening his grip on the core of the Kensington Group. Hiding his fearsome alias Lord Nonus, he allies with Elena to uncover the truth behind his elder brother’s death, lay bare Veronica’s twisted plots, and settle every past score. From a disgraced prison outcast to a dominant tycoon, he strikes with ruthless force to uproot decay, make all wrongdoers pay, and climb to the pinnacle of power to rule the business world.
share_text: 10 Years Jailed! Lord Nonus Ends Veronica!

special_desc: A nobody delivery driver, Wyatt Fletcher, suddenly discovers he is the long-lost heir to the Winslow family — the owners of Starlight Media, a struggling live-streaming empire. Surrounded by scheming rivals like Vaughn Sterling and betrayal within the company, he must rise from the bottom, take control of the failing group, and outplay everyone who once looked down on him. No longer an errand boy, he becomes the boss — and he’s ready to rewrite the rules of the industry.
share_text: They thought he was just a delivery boy. Now he owns the company.

book_title: The Unwilling Heir to an Immortal
special_desc: When security guard Ethan Mercer saves a drugged heiress, Elena Hawthorne, she marries him. But the Hawthorne family sees him as nothing but a kept man who married up for money. Ethan doesn't fight back, but as crisis after crisis strikes the Hawthorne family, Ethan begins to unlock abilities he never knew he had. And somewhere along the way, the woman who married him out of gratitude falls for him for real.
share_text: He never wanted to be a hero or be rich. But fate has other plans...

book_title: Forbidden Night with the Mafia Heir
special_desc: Vince buried his past with Dante, the mob heir who vanished five years ago. When Dante returns, he's still reckless, still devastating, still determined to win Vince back. But Leo, the fragile younger brother Vince saved, wants him too. Caught between two brothers, Vince must decide if the man who broke him once is worth the risk again.
share_text: The mob heir who broke his heart and vanished for five years is back—and this time, he'll burn down the whole family to keep him.

special_desc: In the wake of her father's brutal murder, Emma becomes a target when she digs into the truth. Caught in the crosshairs, a mysterious bodyguard named Liam steps in to save her. Emma, blind but razor-sharp, senses Liam's connection to her father's death. An explosive conspiracy is unfolding, and time is running out...
share_text: He guarded her… to bury the truth.

special_desc: Fiance dumps you, wake up next morning next to a hot escort who might solve your problems.
share_text: Fiance dumps you, wake up next morning next to a hot escort who might solve your problems.

special_desc: Hart has everything: a loving husband, brilliant children, and a quiet life as the wife of Adrian Hart, founder and CEO of HartX Technologies. Her only wound is the family she never knew. When a DNA test confirms that she is the long-lost daughter of the Whitmore family, Serena returns home before Christmas hoping for answers, not inheritance. Instead, she finds a family obsessed with reputation and a false heiress, Sylvia Bellamy, determined to protect the life stolen for her forty years ago. Serena's daughter Ava, a Stanford-bound teen prodigy, is humiliated; Serena's husband is mistaken for a laborer; and every act of patience is repaid with suspicion. As Sylvia's schemes escalate from theft accusations to public slander, Serena's true status as Mrs. Hart becomes the weapon no one saw coming. The story promises a mature heroine's emotional awakening, high-society humiliation, and the ultimate choice between blood relatives and the family that truly chose her.
share_text: She didn't come back for money. She came back to prove she never needed theirs.

special_desc: Sienna Reed set out to reclaim the Jiang Group that had belonged to her late mother. In a twist of fate, she ended up sharing a night with Adrian Voss, the Wolf King. Three days later, the seal on his wolf stone broke, and she conceived his child. Four years later, they crossed paths again. Sienna returned with not one, but two of the Wolf King’s cubs. She fled relentlessly while he chased her down, leaving her with no escape at all. Just as she was convinced he harbored nothing but deep hatred for her, he doted on her beyond measure.
share_text: Does the Wolf King hate me? He spoils me secretly to the extreme.

special_desc: Dumped Selena at their engagement party, calling her a lowly herbalist from a mountain cabin. She didn't cry. She had just discovered she's the true Harrington heiress—but she said nothing. She walked out and struck a deal with Alexander Sinclair, a billionaire left crippled by a "car accident." She would heal his legs; he would back her war. Now she's entering the Harrington mansion, where her birth family protects the fake daughter who stole her life. They think she's an easy target. They don't know she's already won—and the disabled man is about to stand up.
share_text: Dumped for being common, she returned as the true heir and healed the disabled billionaire who would destroy her enemies.

book_title: Crushing All Realms: The Playboy Heir?
special_desc: What! Real transmigration? I'm the Lord Heir engaged to this Princess?
share_text: Transmigration into a Lord Heir? An easy win?

book_title: The Real&Fake Young Master: My Four Aunties Are Big Shots
special_desc: Once an heir to a wealthy family, a genius boy went missing and was picked up by another family, where he was forced into servitude and endured abuse. However, his four powerful aunts—each a legend in her field, from a warrior to a movie star, a divine doctor, and a business mogul—found him and showered him with love, exposing the fake heir and turning the tables!
share_text: A genius boy, once an heir, is now a servant. Four powerful women bring him back to glory!
book_sub_title: The Heir's Return: Four Aunts, One Revenge

book_title: The Double Life of a Billionaire Heiress
special_desc: After three years of marriage, CEO Wes Sterling is convinced that his wife Kira is a cheating gold-digger. Fed up with Wes’s accusations and mistreatments, Kira finally divorces him and re-embraces her true identity...a billionaire heiress! What will Wes do when he realizes he made the biggest mistake of his life? Will Kira make him pay...or fall for him all over again?
share_text: You divorced your husband, but he doesn’t know you’re a secret billionaire!

special_desc:
Kate, an airline heiress, wanted to work as a regular flight attendant without revealing her true identity. But on her first day, Jasmine stole her identity and turned the crew against her.  
Meanwhile, Glen—the captain Kate was supposed to marry for business—fell for her without knowing who she really was. He even wanted to call off their arranged marriage!  
When Kate’s true identity was finally exposed, Jasmine got the humiliation she deserved—and Kate got her happy ending with Glen.
share_text: Flight attendant facade crumbles at 30,000 feet—will true love reach its final destination?

special_desc: Mia grew up in the slums, raised by her grandmother Mrs. Gray. After her grandmother died, she worked as a design intern, resilient and never complaining. Meanwhile, Olivia, the Winston family's fakedaughter,waspamperedandarrogant—seeminglykindbutdeeply jealous and manipulative. When the Winston patriarch needed blood, they discovered Olivia wasn't their biological daughter. Mia, from the slums, was the real Winston heiress. Broughthome,Miafacedcoldrejection:herparentsdespisedher background, her brother remained distant, and Olivia constantly framed her—stealingaccusations,destroyingherdesigns,public humiliation—even plotting with her birth parents to drive Mia out. Mia initially endured, but Olivia's escalating attacks and her family's indifference awakened her. She stopped compromising, established herself in Winston Group's design department, and investigated the baby-switch truth. She met Lucas, a talented lawyer drawn to her resilience. He helped her, providedevidence,anddefendedherwhenframed.Mia'sdesignswon recognition, securing her position. She fought back, exposed Olivia's evil deeds, and uncovered the truth: Olivia's birth parents bribed the Winston servant to switch the babies for a better life. Olivia was expelled. Her birth parents and the servant faced punishment. Mia reclaimed her inheritance, earned her family's recognition, found love with Lucas, and became the Winston Group's core heir—transforming from slum girl to elite heiress.
share_text: Is the slum girl the true heiress?

book_title: Fake Queen Bee, I'm the true Heiress!
special_desc: Seo Hae In, MK Group heiress who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hae In hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life. However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Seo Si Eun, the daughter of the Hae In family's maid, arrives at school posing as the MK Group heiress. Si Eun quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hae In finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.
share_text: Two girls. One crown. Who's the real heiress?

special_desc: Selina Murphy, a wealthy heiress, goes undercover as an intern at her fiancé's company—only to cross paths with Grace, a cunning opportunist from the wrong side of the tracks. Grace brazenly steals Selina's identity and, with the help of their coworkers, relentlessly bullies the "new girl." But Grace picked the wrong target this time. The real heiress is about to fight back.
share_text: From heiress to intern: When a gold-digger steals her identity, she turns the office into a battlefield—one fake smile at a time.

special_desc: Elena Nye, the true heiress of the Nye family, was found after going missing as a child but faced only coldness at home. Fake heiress Natalie Nye stole her boyfriend Caleb Harrington and tricked her into sleeping with a stranger, Adonis Sinclair. Elena later gave birth but, believing her baby had died, fled in heartbreak.
share_text: She returns to claim her light & child!

special_desc: Iris, a rich CEO's wife, harbored regrets for never meeting her biological parents. Upon receiving news of her mom, she took her daughter Eva back to reunite with them. However, the fake daughter Sophie and her brother Lawrence mocked Iris for being crude. At the family dinner, Sophie bragged about her daughter Clara's competition awards, but she didn't know Iris's daughter was a genius. Later, Sophie framed Eva of stealing, and Iris's mom just said Iris was only her goddaughter. Iris felt utterly disappointed. Then her billionaire husband came...

special_desc:
"I had been switched at birth for seventeen years.
When my wealthy biological parents finally found me, they showed up in patched shirts, pretending to be poor. Together with the fake heiress, Seraphina, they threw me into a condemned building and forced me to repay them fifty thousand dollars every month.
Then one day, my mother publicly cursed whoever had framed me, saying they would “go blind and have their legs broken.”
The next morning, on the red carpet at a ball, Seraphina’s eyes bled and both her legs snapped.
Only then did they fall to their knees before me, screaming, “Who the hell are you?”
I lowered my eyes. A flash of dark gold passed through my pupils.
“The witch who didn’t burn on the Salem stake three hundred years ago.”"

book_title: Boss Me Around If You Dare
special_desc: Just after she is falsely accused of sleeping with her boss and fired, Olivia lands a new job at Wilder Conglomerate—only to realize her new boss is Theo Wilder, the man she hooked up with last night! Olivia says they can’t work together, but Theo challenges her to stay and take a bet: he says he can make her fall for him, while Olivia bets she can resist his seduction… but just how long can she last against her boss’ sexy advances?
share_text: An affair with my sexy boss... Bad idea, right?

book_title: My Worst Boss Is My Online Crush
special_desc: She can't stand her boss, and he'd rather tease her than tell her how he feels. When he's sent away to turn around a failing restaurant, he insists she come along. What she doesn't know? Her biggest workplace rival is also the man she's fallen for online.
share_text: He picked me for a business trip—He's my online crush?!

special_desc: A female soldier returns home to protect her children and her late husband's research. An accidental blind date leads to a contract marriage with her brother‑in‑law. At her sister's wedding, she's cornered and humiliated – until her new "husband" arrives to shut them all down.
share_text: Wrong table, right man? Her brother‑in‑law has her back.

special_desc: Tyler Hayden was raised poor, even though his parents were super rich. After college, his girlfriend, Nicky Linden, dumped him to join Sky Corp and teamed up with Felix Clark to go against him. On his first day of work, Tyler helped Mrs. Owen and somehow ended up in a quick marriage with her granddaughter, Maeve Owen, the CEO of Sky Corp. Tyler felt he was not good enough for her and wanted a divorce, but over time, he overcame his insecurities. Later, his dad told him the truth. His family was rich too. But by then, Tyler had already learned that love was not about money.
share_text: From being dumped by his girlfriend to marrying the CEO of Sky Corp, Tyler Hayden must conquer his insecurities and discover that love is worth more than money.

special_desc: Lü Shu, the backbone of the company, gets abruptly fired by the CEO's daughter who just returned from abroad, triggering a massive layoff that cripples the company. What follows is a series of unexpected and captivating twists.
share_text: The employee fired by the CEO's daughter... turns out to be her secret online crush of three years?

book_title: Boss, Your Wife's a Whole Detective!
special_desc: After a flash marriage arranged by her late mother’s best friend, Jenny waits three years for her husband Charles, who left abroad right after the wedding. When he returns, misunderstandings, accusations, and missed chances drive them toward divorce. Just as Jenny is framed by rivals, Charles steps in to protect her, but new twists and family schemes continue to keep them apart.
share_text: A vicious lie forces her estranged husband to protect the wife he never really knew.

book_title: My Nude Chat Partner Is My Boss
special_desc: To pay her mother's medical bills, Luna becomes a masked nude cam host and falls for Mr. Grayson, the private patron who saves her. After graduation, she becomes CEO Will Grayson's assistant, unaware that her strict boss and her online lover are the same man.
share_text: Online lover. Offline boss. Same man.

special_desc: Mia York impersonated heiress Chloe Lynn to attend CEO Silas Ford's matchmaking, demanding huge dowry but unmasked. Silas later became her boss. He enforced a "Ten-Date Pact"; Mia faced false accusations defending Hart Studio but got Silas' covert aid. Posing as "Eve York" to ease his family's marriage pressure, she became his fake girlfriend. Their charade revealed her authenticity and his hidden warmth.​
share_text: Fake romance ignites true love.

special_desc: When Vivian's fiancé, Ethan, disappeared without a trace, her world was turned upside down. For five relentless years, she and their children embarked on an unwavering quest, fueled by love and hope. Just as she was on the brink of despair, a chance encounter reunites them. But the reunion takes a bewildering turn: Ethan insists he's never met her, never been in love, and certainly never fathered a child...
share_text: Dive into a gripping tale of mystery and the unyielding quest for truth.

special_desc: Lucy has a one night stand with a mysterious hottie - who just so happens to be her new boss! When sparks fly at the office will they be able to resist each other?
share_text: What happens when your one-night-stand turns out to be your boss?

special_desc: Bella's arranged marriage becomes a nightmare when she catches her fiancé cheating. Seeking revenge, she sleeps with a stranger, unwittingly bedding her fiancé's powerful mafia boss brother, Damian Gotti. Forced back into the Gotti family, Bella faces dangerous secrets and forbidden desires. Damian relentlessly pursues her under his brother's nose. Eventually, Damian exposes his brother's crimes, saves Bella, and they unite to defend their mafia throne.
share_text: Betrayed by her fiancé, she accidentally slept with his mafia boss brother

book_title: The Mob Boss Demands Her Perfect Genes
special_desc: Elite doc Christine catches mafia boss Damon's eye—her eggs are top-tier, and he wants his heir. She hates his guts: same mob that drove her mom to suicide. She rushes a wedding to escape, but Damon crashes the ceremony and snatches her. Locked in his penthouse, he comes at her hard every night; she fights back twice as hard. But slowly she sees past the ice—when someone drugs her, Damon burns it all down to save her. That twisted, obsessed devotion cracks her open. Christine drops the grudge. They end up together, damaged but locked in.
share_text: He took her to breed his heir. She took his heart instead.

book_title: Boss, We Found Your Dream Girl!
special_desc: A childhood accident erases her memories of him, but they unexpectedly reunite under a misunderstanding. He resolves to help his childhood sweetheart recover her lost memories. Meanwhile, she discovers her boyfriend cheating with her best friend, who she learns is also her half-sister...
share_text: "We've found her, boss! The girl you've always wanted to marry!"

special_desc: By day, Brooklyn is a broke college student from the trailer park. But online, she’s Echo—a fearless gamer gunning for the $50,000 Blackgrove Reign tournament prize, her one shot at freedom. To win, she has to dethrone Thorne, the reigning champion. What she doesn’t know? Thorne is really Ethan—the hot, cocky frat king who also happens to be her TA… and her best friend’s older brother. After they butt heads in real life, Ethan discovers Brooklyn is Echo and enters the game to toy with her—only to find himself drawn to her skill, fire, and spirit. Online, they become unstoppable partners. Offline, they’re bitter rivals. When will Brooklyn realize Ethan is Thorne, and can these sworn enemies stop fighting long enough to see they’re perfect for each other?
share_text: Hate offline. Heat online. Game on.

special_desc: She left him like trash. Now he's a powerful billionaire. She's a wealthy wife with enemies everywhere—her husband's brothers, her vicious ex. But she's done being hunted.
share_text: She dumped him. Now he's rich. And he's on his knees.

book_title: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
special_desc: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns into a heated bet that changes everything. Noah discovers the real reason: Liam is secretly obsessed with him. After Liam saves Noah from bullies, Noah decides to make peace with Liam and tries to straighten him out. But what Noah doesn't realize is that he's walking right into Liam's trap—and slowly being seduced by the one person he should hate most.
share_text: The captain's crush? His stepbrother.

special_desc: When her boyfriend suddenly drops out of their roadtrip to her best friend's wedding, Samantha Smiles is forced to take the long drive from LA to NYC with the boy she's spent the last five years trying to forget. The boy she spent one secret summer night with. The boy she let take ALL her firsts: Tristan Montgomery, AKA her best friend's older brother! Torn between loyalty and her resurfacing (mutual?) feelings for Tristan, Samantha has to make a choice: will she keep living for others, or will she finally, for once, do something for herself?!
share_text: Four days alone with my best friend's brother?!

book_title: I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy
special_desc: During her first year in high school, Hannah Morrow is losing her virginity to the powerful Jamie St. Clair in their prestigious private school’s library. Jamie breaks up with her in front of the whole school and she loses her scholarship. When the two are reunited their final year, they fake a relationship despite hating each other. But real feelings lay underneath their fake relationship. Will Hannah get back the boy who broke her heart? Or will she lose everything when their fake relationship is exposed?
share_text: My fake boyfriend is the school's hottest bad boy.

special_desc: He wrapped around me and threw me into the abyss. Now I'm back, 100lbs lighter and armed with a "love point" system. The snake wants my blood. The wolf wants my heart. But that serpent? He just locked the door, and his scales are trembling.
share_text: The beast who killed me now guards my door.

special_desc:
When Scarlett was eighteen, her parents were brutally murdered for helping bring down a drug cartel. To protect her younger siblings, Scarlett let the world believe she was the villain — playing the disgrace of the family while she spent years quietly hunting the killers down, until she finally destroyed them all.

Ten years later, Scarlett is dying of a terminal illness — despised by the very siblings she sacrificed everything for. Now powerful and successful, they decide to use a memory-extraction machine to broadcast Scarlett's every memory to the world, determined to expose her crimes and put her on trial. But the deeper they dig, the more they realize Scarlett was never the person they thought she was…
share_text: A memory ripped from her against her will — and ten years of silent sacrifice finally comes to light.

book_title: Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village
special_desc: In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a community-wide meeting to judge him.
share_text: Discover a gripping tale of love and defiance in a village bound by tradition. Will they prevail?

book_title: Her Man Is the Son of Death
special_desc: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod disguised as a beggar finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must reveal his true identity to protect her, risking the secret he was bound to keep.
share_text: A demigod uses his powers to defeat evil.

book_title: Spoiling Me, Spoiling You - The Rich Wife's Sweet Game
special_desc: After dying on a night shift, nurse Sophia wakes up as the wife of a top tycoon. But she's immediately accused of being a mistress by the original wife's bitter ex, who even threatens her life. The husband, Spencer, is rich, handsome, and heirless, so Sophia decides to charm him into securing her future. To her surprise, this cold, woman-hating man turns into a loving, doting husband who can't get enough of her.
share_text: She wasn't meant to be his wife, but now she's stealing his heart.

book_title: Four-Fingered Dad Helps Me Slap Back
special_desc: Fifteen years ago, a father lost his finger while protecting his daughter, leading to their separation. Now, she faces betrayal from her ex-boyfriend, scorn from her family for her job as a water delivery worker, and the death of her adoptive father due to humiliation. As she struggles, her biological father—now a wealthy man—suddenly returns to take her home. However, the reunion is complicated by another woman who claims to be the true heiress, sparking imminent family conflict.
share_text: My Billionaire dad found me, I'm finally ready to get revenge on those who betrayed me!
book_sub_title: Rich Dad Returns: Poor Daughter's Life Takes Off

special_desc: Nolan Hayes is a delivery guy humiliated by his cheating girlfriend and a rich rival. Then he finds a mysterious bracelet that unlocks crazy powers—including glimpses of the future. Suddenly, nine powerful, stunning women show up, claiming to be his "adoptive sisters." They help him turn the tables on everyone who wronged him, fight back against the elites, and rise from rock bottom to become absolutely unstoppable. Expect payback, romance, and non-stop twists.
share_text: What if one magic bracelet gave you the future—and nine sisters who'd burn the world for you?

book_title: Abandoned by the Duke, I'm the Divine Seraph
special_desc:
After defeating Pope Pari in a contest of strength, Percy wins his approval—but declines the papacy to search for his origins. Guided by the Pope, he arrives in Crow Territory, rescues his sister, and reaches the Cohen family, only to find them under siege by the Ross family.

His mother reveals the truth of his birth and urges him to flee. Moved, Percy defeats the invaders Brienne and Fiona, and encounters Mia of the Outflow Church, who has been searching for him.

Brienne and Fiona are rescued and transformed by the fallen mage Cru. Fiona evolves into an evil dragon. Percy is defeated and nearly killed. Mia saves him at the cost of her own life. Percy awakens the Sun God's blessing, heals Mia, transforms into a seraph, and slays Fiona.

Cru flees. Percy returns Mia to the Church, refuses the papacy again, and chooses to hunt down Cru.
share_text: He was meant to rule. He chose to fight.

book_title: My Dead Ex Came Back Rich
special_desc: Five years ago, she divorced him to save her family—then watched him fall from the sky. He didn't die. He came back as a billionaire, hungry for revenge. Now he owns her as his servant, never knowing she kept his son a secret. But the deeper he digs, the more he finds her painful truth: she sold everything to find him, even borrowed money for his grave. When his son is in danger, revenge turns into regret—and love rises from the ashes.
share_text: She divorced him to save him. He came back to break her. Then he learned everything.

book_title: We Ditched the Plot and Got Rich
special_desc: Two best friends, both worn down by the grind of corporate life, were unexpectedly transported into a cheesy romance novel, becoming the book's foolish female side characters — wealthy heiresses who were obsessing over worthless men. The two hit it off instantly, ditching the original characters' idiotic behavior. They decided to use their fortune to live easy, kick the scumbag to the curb, crush the scheming rivals, enjoy their wealth in peace, find true love, and end up as sisters-in-law — completely rewriting their miserable fate into a story of two women who won without breaking a sweat.
share_text: Side characters? No. They're the main characters now.

special_desc: After World War III, I became a scavenger in a chaotic world, surviving by trading salvaged junk for supplies—while being bullied by classmates who would steal what I'd gathered. By chance, I discovered alien technology and rescued three beautiful women who became my wives. Now, I aim to use these assets to become the King of the Wasteland!
share_text: With alien tech, I become the Wasteland King.

book_title: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees
special_desc: Cain Hunter is a broken man after his wife betrays him and ruins him financially. Just as all hope is lost, Cain is suddenly brought to the mysterious Don Ludwig, who makes him an offer: pass his tests, and Cain will succeed him as the new Godfather of Bourne Syndicate.
share_text: A new Godfather's in town... and he wants revenge.

special_desc:
To the world, Nate Ryder is a failure whose Awakening ended in disgrace. But Nate knows the truth: he awakened the SSS-rank Thunder God—the rarest power on Earth.

His father sold his health for a vial of Awakening serum. His mother has been paralyzed for ten years, yet she's the reason he never gives up. At school, the elite bully Tyler—an A-rank prodigy—crushes that serum and works with corrupt administrators to bar Nate from the national tournament.

Facing relentless humiliation, Nate hides his power and bides his time. Every insult, every injustice becomes fuel for his training.

Then the Federal Awakened Selection Tournament begins. Tyler, determined to defeat Nate in front of thousands, steps into the arena—expecting a hopelessly one-sided fight. Instead, Nate unleashes his SSS-rank Thunder God. In one electrifying moment, the "worthless failure" shocks the world—and begins his unstoppable rise to the top.
share_text: SSS-rank power. Hidden in silence. Unleashed in thunder.

book_title: My Dead Ex Came Back Rich
special_desc: While undergoing heavenly tribulation for ascension, Daoist Grandmaster Aurora transmigrates into a wicked villainess facing divorce. Handed a payoff check, a confused Aurora silently roasts the tragic fate of Christian Sterling's family, unaware they can hear her inner thoughts. With Aurora's help, Christian Sterling manages to defy the heavens and change fate, uncovering the true culprit and rewriting his family's destiny.
share_text: Grandmaster to villainess! Thoughts save all!

book_title: Spend on Her, Get 10,000X Back in the Apocalypse
special_desc: After his girlfriend sells him out to a death game, James unlocks a system that turns every coin spent on female monsters into ten thousand—and with it, he conquers monstrous bosses, crushes the elite, and seizes total dominion over the end of the world.
share_text: Death game. Monster harem. Total dominion.

share_text: She wasn't meant to be his wife, but now she's stealing his heart.

share_text: Beggar? He's a dragon!

special_desc: He found himself stranded on a deserted island with two alluring women. With survival skills in his hands, he gradually won over the beautiful women who initially looked down on him.
share_text: You and two pretty ladies end up on a deserted island...

special_desc: Newlywed wife Emma was on her honeymoon in Hawaii when her husband Jack arranged for her father-in-law Victor to teach her how to surf. The husband was piloting a motorboat ahead, sharing a surfboard with Emma. Victor tightly hugged Emma from behind, experiencing a sustained and secretive desire that gradually spiraled out of control amidst the intense waves. Emma and Victor engaged in a forbidden love affair.
share_text: She came for a honeymoon. She left with a forbidden flame.

share_text: My boyfriend cheated on me with his good brother, so don't blame me for seducing their CEO friend！

special_desc: Seventeen‑year‑old Stella moves into a wealthy coastal mansion after her mother remarries, where she meets Vincent, her cold, sharp‑tongued step‑brother. Behind his elite heir image, Vincent dominates the competitive surfing circle—possessive and starved for love. They clash fiercely at first, but living under the same roof, quiet curiosity grows into a silent, undeniable bond. He teases her openly, yet fiercely protects her—and she slowly falls for his exclusive affection. When betrayal leaves Stella shattered, Vincent is the only one who stays. At a surfing competition, he's injured by rivals. Stella steps in and wins to protect his honor. He later risks everything to shield her. Breaking every rule as nominal step‑siblings, they begin a forbidden romance—distant in public, intensely intimate in private.
share_text: He was her step‑brother. She was his forbidden fire. In public, strangers. In private, everything.

special_desc: The night before her arranged wedding, Harper Sullivan bedded a hot stranger. At the family banquet, a teasing voice remarked that she looked familiar. She looked up, only to find the revered "Mr. Lucas" was the man from last night. Now, by day, she plays the obedient wife. By night, clingy Mr. Lucas whispers that it's her turn to call him darling.
share_text: Pre-wedding fling? He's her fiancé's uncle! Obedient by day, darling by night.

book_title: Addicted to My Ex's Uncle: Forbidden Tenderness
special_desc: Eve is haunted by steamy recurring dreams of a faceless mystery man. At a party, she meets him at last: Kai, a powerful mafia kingpin and also her boyfriend’s uncle.The dangerous Kai disregards morals to chase her. Eve struggles to resist him, but every heated entanglement stirs her hidden longing. She suffers a brutal inner battle between shame and craving.
share_text: Her boyfriend's uncle is the one who haunts her nights.

book_title: Forbidden Bonds: Fated to the Ocean God
special_desc: For years, demigod Elena endured the arrogance and cruelty of Alec, Sovereign of Olympus—only to have him reject her on her eighteenth birthday. But fate gives her a second chance when she meets Stefano, the powerful King of the Titans. His choice is immediate and public, "I want her. No one else." Just as Elena finally finds her true match, Alec and his lover set out to destroy them. Can Elena escape their trap, and will Stefano save her in time?
share_text: Orphans get no second chance. Fate gave me one at 18. Sovereign of Olympus rejected me, but I'm the long-lost daughter of Sun God!

special_desc: After her mother's remarriage thrusts her into the glamorous yet unfamiliar world of a chaebol family, Yi Seo finds herself living under the same roof as Ji Seung-hyun—her seemingly perfect but emotionally distant stepbrother. From the moment they meet, the two clash relentlessly, unable to stand each other. But as their constant battles give way to stolen glances and undeniable chemistry, the line between family and forbidden desire begins to blur. In a world where every emotion comes with a price, can they resist a love that should never exist?
share_text: Falling for my stepbrother— A line that must never be crossed

book_title: Forbidden Curse: Rise of the Godslayer
special_desc: Evan makes gods kneel with Forbidden Curses!
share_text: With a System, spells become Forbidden Curses!

Everyone thinks Knox hates him, but Cole soon finds the truth: Knox has been watching, writing about him, and waiting to cross the line. When their forbidden relationship leaks, Cole's first-line spot is taken and Knox's career is at risk. The team thinks Cole slept his way up. Cole answers on the ice. He wins the game, proves Knox chose right, and walks straight into a relationship built on control, obsession, and a ring.
share_text: His coach was off-limits. Knox risked his career to claim Cole anyway.

special_desc: After her father, the President, is assassinated, Nova becomes a target of dangerous political enemies. When her father’s best friend and former special forces officer Grant Steele is sent to protect her as her personal bodyguard, Nova immediately distrusts him, seeing him as a hypocrite just like her deceased father. When she uncovers his dark BDSM secrets, she decides to use it against him, trying to seduce him to prove her point. But the more she pushes him, the more she finds herself drawn to his strength and vulnerability. As the two grow closer, their bond deepens, and the lines between manipulation and love blur while they fight to survive against the conspirators who will stop at nothing to destroy her.
share_text: President's daughter seduces bodyguard to destroy him, but falls for him instead.

special_desc: Enslaved by the Alpha who slaughtered her family, Lyra is forced to the altar until his son Asher kills him and claims her. Their fated bond ignites, but Asher hides her and takes political Luna Selene to shield her. Selene's jealousy explodes into brutal torture, forcing his cruelty to mask his devotion. When Selene and brother Garrick's coup erupts into war, Lyra reveals she is a lost Alpha's daughter and helps crush it, killing Garrick herself. Selene is exiled, and Lyra is crowned his equal.
share_text: Enslaved by the killer of her family, Lyra is fated mate to his son, the new Alpha. He claims her in blood, then hides her to survive. Can love born of violence survive the throne's cruelest game?

special_desc: Rejected by your mate, you feel hopeless and dejected, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for you!
share_text: Rejected by your mate, you feel hopeless and dejected, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for you!

special_desc: Born with super strength, Dorin hid her martial arts talent since women were barred from martial arts. When Sky City and the Mann family were in danger, only Dorin could fight for them. Tricked into destroying her powers to save her kin, she watched them perish. Saved and healed by a master, Dorin returns for revenge.
share_text: Born with great strength, the world deemed her worthless. Now she's a queen!

special_desc: Rejected by her partner, Selena feel hopeless and discouraged, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for her!
share_text: Rejected by her mate, she has another mate and become Alpha!

special_desc: The day her relationship ended, she hit the bar looking for a rebound. Instead, she landed her ex‑boyfriend's younger cousin – the untouchable ice prince of the elite circle, and the only person her ex is terrified of. Her ex loses his mind.
share_text: Dumped him, then hooked his nightmare.

special_desc: Leo has always been one rank behind Jaxon, the star quarterback who takes everything Leo wants, including his crush, the hottest girl on campus. What Leo doesn't know is that Jaxon is secretly in love with him. So Jaxon tanks an exam on purpose, then makes Leo an offer — Tutor me to keep my captaincy, and I'll teach you how to win your dream girl. Studying calculus by day, dating lessons by night — and one plan Leo never accounted for, falling for his romance coach, his biggest rival.
share_text: My romance coach, my biggest rival, and the trap I fell for.

book_title: Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance
special_desc: Facing family pressure to quit college and marry, Clarisse's world changes when she meets Austin, the CEO of Lloyd Group after helping his grandmother after a scam. Learning about her financial struggles, he offers her money in exchange for a fake marriage to fulfill his grandmother's wish. They form an unexpected alliance, while Austin keep his true identity a secret from her.
share_text: An unexpected proposal, a hidden truth, and a love that defies the odds.

special_desc: Rockstar Dexter Hayes thinks he found his next hit when he dumps his loyal assistant Casey for rising star Scarlett Hart. What he doesn’t know is that Casey is living a double life as Echo, the mysterious super-producer who built his career and secretly owns his label. As the truth unravels, can Dexter and Casey can find their way back to the music, and to each other?
share_text: Her secret built his fame. Now SHE owns the stage!

book_title: Fatal Attraction: A Dark Mafia Romance
special_desc: To avenge her mother, Daisy disguises herself as a dancer to get close to the dangerous mafia boss, Hogan. Despite suspecting Daisy's intentions, Hogan finds himself irresistibly drawn to her deadly charm. Will Daisy manage to walk away unscathed, or will she be entangled in passion with Hogan?
share_text: You took my mother—now I’ll take everything from you.

book_title: My Homeless Hubby Is a Trillionaire
special_desc: On the eve of her wedding, she discovers her fiancé's infidelity. In a fit of anger, she marries a stranger on a whim. Little did she know that her handsome homeless husband is actually a trillionaire CEO!
share_text: You married a guy you found on the street, but he turned out to be the right one!
book_sub_title: From Rags to Riches: CEO Romance

special_desc: A heartwarming and delightful Christmas rom-com, fun for the whole family. Madeline Leon (Workin' Moms) gives a cozy, relatable lead performance, creating a lovely, entertaining cinematic experience.
share_text: The owner of a historic inn enters a cooking contest to win funds for renovations and get free publicity. But she’s a horrible cook! Luckily, a renowned chef is a guest...
