share_text: Discover the unexpected twists in Zoe and Julian's whirlwind romance!

special_desc: Leo, the prodigious heir of the Divine Healer, descends from the mountains to find his engagement abruptly canceled by his fiancée, Isabelle, who dismisses him as a mere country boy and relegates him to the morgue. To everyone's astonishment, Leo revives the CEO, Eleanor, in the morgue, leaving the entire hospital in awe. With his unparalleled medical and martial arts prowess, Leo swiftly carves out a remarkable reputation in the city, navigating complex relationships with Isabelle, Eleanor, and other intriguing women.
share_text: From mountain exile to city legend...

special_desc: An unexpected event forces recently graduated and directionless Mia Bennett to replace her younger bro as the supporting lead in the blockbuster movie Midnight Reverie. Entering showbiz by cross-dressing as a rookie, Mia must hide her true identity from eagle-eyed fans while dodging pranks from Top Actor Asher Vance, who has a bad impression of her. With zero industry experience, Mia's hilarious blunders spark a series of dramatic mishaps. Over time, her co-stars grow to love the charming Mia, while Top Actor Asher Vance and hit idol Jace Monroe develop feelings for her that go way beyond friendship.
share_text: Cross-dressing in showbiz, love can't hide.

book_title: Fake It Till We Make It
special_desc: A once-privileged heiress, now facing financial struggles, steps in for a friend at a blind date with a wealthy second-generation tycoon to cover her mother's mounting medical bills. Aiming to sabotage the date with her unappealing antics, she is stunned when her plans backfire, leading to an unexpected marriage!
share_text: A struggling heiress tries to sabotage a blind date with a tycoon, but ends up unexpectedly married!

special_desc: How many times have you been in love? How many times were you wrong? Now, imagine falling for someone who kills, only for you. Would that thrill you? Alice Walters is no ordinary girl. With intellect as sharp as her beauty, she's been through enough heartbreaks to believe her heart is beyond repair. Yearning for true love, she dreams of a relationship worth giving her all to—but she is unprepared for the storm that is Arthur Edwards. Arthur Edwards has a dark talent for murder. Whether through sheer luck or meticulous planning, he's never been caught. As his reputation as a serial killer begins to grow, he meets Alice, and she's all he needs to start a killing spree targeting her ex-lovers...
share_text: Would you date a murderer if he avenged your heartbreaks?

book_title: The Top Student Is a Mob Boss
special_desc: A ruthless mob boss dies saving Vivian and wakes up in her body. Determined to start over and earn her place at college, she discovers she's the school's worst student, bullied by a fake heiress and her own family. Now she's ready to fight back—until her long-lost sister returns to claim the throne.
share_text: She was reborn as a top student. The fake heiress picked the wrong girl!

book_title: When I Can See My Students' Hidden Potentials
special_desc: When Della Avery arrived as the new principal, her first bold move was to appoint Jeromy Munoz—the school's janitor—as the headteacher of its worst class. But Jeromy wasn't ordinary. After a strange turn of fate, he gained a magic system, allowing him to see the hidden talents of each student. As he awakened the potential of these so-called failures, the class began to rise fast. The monthly exam turned into battlegrounds, and the underdogs began defeating the school's top students...
share_text: They called them losers—until he saw their true power.

special_desc: A student at a Catholic school has suspicions when one of the nuns begins acting creepily towards her brother. But she can't tell anyone, because who would believe that a woman of God would do such a thing?
share_text: Conflict-filled tale of temptation and desire. Features steamy romance scenes as well as unpredictable thrills.

book_title: Fuel to Our Fire: My Racer Stepbrother
special_desc: Struggling to pay the bills to support her ailing mother and abusive step-father, Elaine turns to her work as a dancer at illegal street races. But, as fate would have it, she unknowingly runs into the world's most-feared and envied world-championship street racer... her step-brother. And gives him her virginity.
share_text: I slept with my stepbrother and he has no clue!

book_title: The Ice Hockey Star Regrets Deeply
special_desc: I gave my virginity to save my drugged stepbrother. He married me because I was pregnant... then killed me on our wedding night. When I woke up, I was back to the night everything began. This time, I sent his beloved woman to his bed, gave up my inheritance, and fell for the man who truly loved me. But just when I stopped loving him, my stepbrother uncovered the truth. “I was wrong… Please marry me.” I smiled. “Too late. The woman who died in that fire will never love you again.”
share_text: He killed me once. Now he's begging for the love I buried in the fire.

special_desc: With every slow, even breath Noah takes, my stepbrother Hunter's hands behind me grow bolder, sliding and pressing against the fabric between us. This tent is packed with dozing classmates, I'm a helpless lamb, trapped in his silent game. Never felt a thrill like this, my heart thunders in my ears like a war drum. I clutch my sleeping bag, bite my lip till it bleeds, and pray not a single sound escapes.
share_text: Classmates sleep. He doesn't.

book_title: Mistaken for My Brother-in-law's Sex Doll
special_desc: Lucy is a pawn in a high-society arranged marriage, married off to her playboy husband, Dylan. Then her husband's betrayal, her half-sister's schemes, and her family's indifference push Lucy deeper and deeper into despair. One night, Ethan, a mafia boss and Dylan's half-brother, mistakes Lucy for a "lifelike sex doll." Under Ethan's cold, scorching domination, Lucy wakes up to herself. She knows she has fallen into a web of taboo, revenge, and extreme desire. She decides she will no longer be anyone's sacrifice. She will become her brother-in-law's perfect toy, belonging only to him. With her body and soul, she will personally destroy everyone who betrayed her.
share_text: My husband betrayed me—so I took his brother.

special_desc:
Christmas Eve. After Thistle is publicly torn apart for still being a virgin, she makes a desperate wish to Santa: "Please let me lose it."
Thistle never expects the one who answers her wish to be the campus bad boy, mafia heir... and her soon-to-be stepbrother.
share_text: Virgin's Christmas wish: answered by her mafia stepbrother.

special_desc: Silas is trapped inside a deadly psychiatric hospital instance where every room hides a kill rule and every creature is ranked S-Class for lethality. Just when death seems certain, a Romance Conquest System activates in his mind — turning every monster into a love target and every trap into a dating sim.
share_text: Death dungeon? Nah. Dating sim.

special_desc: James Witt wakes up 10 years later: his body was hijacked by an imposter who divorced his soulmate, Jocelyn. Now back in control but facing two ruthless rivals, James must fight tooth and nail to redeem his past and win back his family.
share_text: Body stolen, wife lost. He's fighting back!

book_title: Hey There, I Can Hear Your Heart!
special_desc: Banished from the heavens for meddling in divine gossip, the god of wealth reincarnated as Penny, a newlywed rural girl who was unwelcome by her in-laws and ultimately killed by her husband's childhood sweetheart. Now reborn, Penny decides to rewrite her fate. However, the Shane family discovers they can hear her thoughts! Initially skeptical and dismissive of Penny's warnings, they gradually realize the truth as her thoughts repeatedly prove accurate, turning their world upside down.
share_text: Back to challenging her hateful family!

special_desc:
U.S. figure skater Camila walks off the World Championship ice with silver — defeated by her ruthless arch-rival Sophia.
Backstage, she runs into Scarlett: her long-time secret crush, the retired legendary champion. And she stumbles straight into the scene: Sophia cheating with Scarlett's husband.
To yank the woman she loves away from the cheating scumbag, Camila gives Scarlett an ultimatum:
Be my exclusive full-time coach. Or I leak the affair proof to the whole world.
Trapped to save her public reputation, Scarlett has no choice but to agree...
share_text: On ice, she's chasing glory. Off ice, she's stealing a heart.

special_desc: In a whirlwind of love and betrayal, Lucie Teague and Felix Young's romance shatters when a cruel misunderstanding tears them apart. Lucie, desperate to protect Felix from danger, sacrifices their love, only to meet him again years later as a billionaire CEO... and her new boss! With secrets and lies between them, Lucie must navigate her new job under Felix's watchful eye and endure the torment of her conniving younger sister Elena, the new girl on Felix's arm, all while hiding the truth that could either reunite them or destroy them forever.
share_text: Cold revenge or long-lost love… which will win?

book_title: How to Tame a Royal Heart
special_desc: Clara Chavez, the daughter of a wealthy merchant, is reborn on the night of her wedding, where her groom, Cole Kerrigan, humiliates her by marrying his sister-in-law as well. Determined to reject this fate, Clara vows revenge and sets out to reclaim everything she has lost. Along her journey, she forms a profound bond with Prince Adrian, leading to the Kerrigan family's downfall and securing her rightful place in the royal lineage, ultimately finding happiness with Adrian.
share_text: Reborn on her wedding night, Clara defies destiny and triumphs against all odds.

book_title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die
special_desc: In search of the truth behind her sister’s death, Zoe Hale marries billionaire Ashton Cross, whom she suspects to be the killer. However, as she gets to know him better, she discovers truth more twisted, and love more powerful than she could’ve ever imagined.
share_text: You want the truth and you want revenge -- but both hurts when you're in love.

special_desc: The family's beloved heiress vanished without a trace eighteen years ago. Her three billionaire brothers have turned every stone, burned every bridge—and they're still losing their minds not knowing where she is.
share_text: Gone for 18 years. Her billionaire brothers are losing it.

special_desc: After losing her grandma, Mila meets Xavier, a disgraced rich heir who pays for her grandma's funeral. Mila decides to use her special powers to clear his name. Though not blood-related, they form an unbreakable bond. Two broken hearts start to mend.
share_text: She chose her own family.

book_title: A Kiss on Your Faded Heart
special_desc: Ava's artificial heart is failing when she runs into her first love, Adrian. Five years ago, she was forced to leave him. Her mother had Ava’s real heart ripped out to save her supposed daughter, Madison. Worse, Adrian still believes Ava simply abandoned him, and he’s now about to marry Madison. But when he learns why Ava really left and what Madison did to her, the wedding begins to fall apart.
share_text: They Ripped Out My Heart. It Still Beat for Him.

special_desc: A strict, abstinent CEO discovers that due to a rare condition, he won’t live past thirty. By chance, he learns that a poor college student is the only one who can heal him. Desperate to survive, he forces her into marriage. Over time, she falls in love with him and sacrifices herself to save his life. Believing she died in the process, he is devastated. But seven years later, fate brings her back into his life—blind and with a child.
share_text: She sacrificed herself to save him, but seven years later, he discovers she's alive, with a child.

special_desc: An ordinary guy, Max, gets a system that grants him all sorts of skills. Just as he's about to win the ultimate prize, one bad review from Rita resets everything. Desperate to fix his rating, he goes all out to win her over!
share_text: He just wanted a good review, but he got a girlfriend!

book_title: Not His Blood, But His Heart
special_desc: Framed by her boyfriend and sent to prison, Annette Switt is offered a way out: save a tycoon's life with her blood. She seizes the chance, only to return home and discover his betrayal. Heartbroken, she marries the powerful Alexander Fletcher in a swift, convenient arrangement. But when revenge turns to real connection, they join forces to take down those who wronged her—and find an unexpected family along the way.
share_text: She married for revenge. He married for convenience.

special_desc: Owing her life to the heart donated by her sister, the girl is determined not to waste it. With the support of a billionaire CEO, she seeks vengeance against those who wronged both her and her sister...
share_text: It was supposed to be all business but turned out to be much more heartfelt...

book_title: Fake it Till You Love Me
special_desc: Being betrayed by her fiance, Caroline got drunk and in bed with her billionaire boss Edward...which becomes the biggest headline all over the country!  Caroline has no choice but agree to play Edward's wife. Their fake relationship has to get past Edward's strict grandma, insidious brother...and themselves.
share_text: Your fiance leaves you, but he doesn't know you'll soon become a billionaire's wife.

book_title: Fake Married to My Billionaire CEO
special_desc: After Sam's ex cheats on her and steals her money, Calladan Vandalay marries her at first sight. But he doesn't tell her that he's secretly the richest billionaire in the country. What will Sam do when she finds out? And can they keep their true identities a secret from the preying family and friends in Sam's life?
share_text: Keep your friends close and your enemies closer when marrying a secret billionaire!

book_title: Fake It Till You Make It
special_desc: To get back at her cheating ex, Nancy boldly claims that the elusive big shot, Ethan, is her boyfriend, and overhears the lie. To her shock, Ethan not only plays along but also marries her to lift his ailing grandmother's spirits. They agree to part ways once she recovers, but as they live together, sparks fly, and Ethan discovers Nancy is the miracle doctor he's been searching for. What began as a lie turns into fate.
share_text: One lie, one wedding, and a love neither saw coming.

book_title: Fake Heiress Stole My Family? I have Mr. CEO!
special_desc: True heiress Juliet gives the Thorn family everything, only to be sold out by her brother. Fate plays its hand: she flash-marries Maxwell Davenport, the CEO who spoils her rotten. Every sweet kiss heals a wound. Every cruel betrayal from the Thorns fuels her fire. By the time they realize Juliet was their only treasure, it's too late.The whole family is on its knees. And she's not looking back.
share_text: Once their pawn, now another's treasure. Kneeling? Too late!

special_desc: Iris, a rich CEO's wife, harbored regrets for never meeting her biological parents. Upon receiving news of her mom, she took her daughter Eva back to reunite with them. However, the fake daughter Sophie and her brother Lawrence mocked Iris for being crude. At the family dinner, Sophie bragged about her daughter Clara's competition awards, but she didn't know Iris's daughter was a genius. Later, Sophie framed Eva of stealing, and Iris's mom just said Iris was only her goddaughter. Iris felt utterly disappointed. Then her billionaire husband came...
share_text: Even though I'm her biological daughter, she doesn't love me.

special_desc: Ben, a famous celebrity actor, is on the height of success. But soon, his career comes at a risk when he is rumored to date another famous male celebrity. Allen(Ben's manager) offers Blake to be Ben's fake date for a while, until the rumors settle down. Ben and Blake start to blend in together, and go exclusive to suppress the rumors. Hearing the ongoing drama, Ria(Ben's ex-girlfriend) suspects their relationship, hence digs more into their lives. Soon, Ria unveils Blake's reality and the whole set-up to the world...
share_text: To bury one rumor, they started another—until his ex-girlfriend exposed their lie.

special_desc: Down on his luck, Caleb McGovern awakens the "Make-It-Real" System, where any fake becomes reality! When a scam text from a stock genius's "illegitimate son" pops up, Caleb plays along and receives $10 billion! He even buys a supreme combat skill for just $9.99, gaining the strength to fight 10 men at once! Now, reality bends to his will. His word is law! He can turn any fake into reality!
share_text: Broke guy gets a system: fake becomes real!

book_title: My Fake Girlfriend Is My Fiancée
special_desc: Alexander gets tricked off his mountain and lands in the city with nothing. A mystery beauty offers him a fake boyfriend job. Plot twist? She's his runaway fiancée Kathryn. One fake date. One real marriage. Plus lots of fighting.
share_text: Fake boyfriend? Turns out she’s my real fiancée!

special_desc: On Alexis Bancroft's wedding day, her father, Raymond Bancroft, plans to name her Chairman. But his retirement post sparks rumors of the Bancroft family's bankruptcy! Snobs show their true colors, and her fiancé's family publicly humiliates her. Seeing their betrayal, Alexis calls her sister, Supreme Commander Natasha. Now, the Bancroft heiress is out for blood!
share_text: Bankruptcy? She is on a rampage!

book_title: I Faked My Death To Ruin My Mafia Husband
special_desc: "You're lying." That's what my husband said when I begged him to save me. Six months pregnant, I was kidnapped, beaten, and left to lose our baby—while he chose his mistress over me again and again. So I gave him exactly what he deserved: my death. Now he thinks he buried his wife and daughter. But I'm still alive... and this time, I'll bury everything he loves.
share_text: He chose his mistress. I buried our marriage—and let him bury my "body."

book_title: He Made Me Kneel Before the Fake Saintess
special_desc: Once the strongest rope guide of the Sacred Mountain, Evelyn was framed after an avalanche by the beloved Saintess Celeste, who claimed Evelyn cut the rescue rope and left her crippled. Her fiancé, Duke Adrian, believed the lie. For three years, Evelyn knelt on frozen steps to pay for her brother Noah’s medicine and keep the orphanage alive. On the final step, Adrian orders her to kneel and lick Celeste’s boots. Then a black raven arrives with Noah’s death notice. With nothing left to lose, Evelyn tears up the atonement contract and drags the Saintess’s perfect lie into the light.
share_text: On the day her fiancé forced her to lick the fake saintess’s boots, her brother died—and the woman who rose from the snow would make them all pay.
